dossier.claim: The English sometimes changes when an event occurs, whether it has occurred, or what interval or continuing condition the source specifies.
dossier.sourcePattern: The Japanese distinguishes a duration of cursing from its object, a present victory claim from an earlier defeat, a ten-second pause from an unspecified short interval, imminent impact from actual injury, and a later exam from tomorrow. It also places magical training below the one-hour threshold.
dossier.englishEffect: Eternity becomes another object to curse, Shinji’s current boast becomes a past counterfactual, and a spear is said to stab before the ensuing passage diverts it before impact. Hiding gains an until-recovery condition, a later retake becomes tomorrow, and just under an hour becomes a little over an hour. A comic ten-second pause becomes a few seconds, while Archer’s condemnation shifts from becoming the role to having tried to become it.
dossier.limits: The next minute can mean the next moment, and ordinary tense shifts need not alter chronology. Rin’s one-hour-fast clocks also prevent convicting the alarm’s direction from the displayed time alone. The selected cases use stronger temporal or aspectual constraints. Counterexamples retain a time-reversal simile, forgetting at the next summoning, and the correction of the clock error.
dossier.diagnostic: 547 findings in this category; 8 cited passages.

findings.sourceReading: Shirou hears pattering/bustling sounds continue for several minutes; the action and its purpose remain unstated.
findings.explanation: Several minutes of unexplained commotion become Rin running around in search of something.

contexts.japanese: バタバタという音が続くこと数分
contexts.english: I can hear her running around the room for something.

findings.description: This one uneventful interval becomes plural simple times spent together.
findings.sourceReading: Precisely because only fading memory remains, Shirou resolves to engrave this specific time in which nothing happened onto his heart.
findings.explanation: This one uneventful interval becomes plural simple times spent together.

contexts.japanese: このなんでもなかった時間を強く胸に刻んでおこう
contexts.english: I'll make sure I keep the memories of the simple times we've spent together close to my heart

findings.description: Rin watching until sunset becomes the jumper trying until sunset.
findings.sourceReading: 意味もなく modifies her sustained watching; his repeated runs were already stated.
findings.explanation: Rin watching until sunset becomes the jumper trying until sunset.

contexts.japanese: 意味もなく、日が沈むまで
contexts.english: It was meaningless, yet he kept trying until sunset.

findings.description: Shirou being unable to finish becomes Rin refusing to hear him out.
findings.sourceReading: He does not get to hear or ask through to the end before ejection.
findings.explanation: Shirou being unable to finish becomes Rin refusing to hear him out.

contexts.japanese: 最後まで聞けなかった
contexts.english: She won't hear me out at all.

findings.description: Moving outward becomes already going outside despite there being no exit.
findings.sourceReading: Rin inches toward the outside while watching the tentacles; the next sentence says no exit exists.
findings.explanation: Moving outward becomes already going outside despite there being no exit.

contexts.japanese: 少しずつ外へと移動する
contexts.english: She slowly goes outside

findings.description: A momentary repulsion of the mud becomes a fast repulsion.
findings.sourceReading: ほんの僅かな時間ではあるが limits how long the arrows keep the black mud away.
findings.explanation: A momentary repulsion of the mud becomes a fast repulsion.

contexts.japanese: ほんの僅かな時間ではあるが、黒い泥は弾かれ
contexts.english: In just a short time the black mud is repelled

findings.description: An actual failed inquiry and Lancer's teasing become a hypothetical question.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou did ask and Lancer did needle Rin, but she refused to explain to either.
findings.explanation: An actual failed inquiry and Lancer's teasing become a hypothetical question.

contexts.japanese: 俺が訊いてもランサーが茶化しても教えてくれなかった
contexts.english: She wouldn't tell us even if we asked

findings.description: Rin's casual thanks just heard becomes gratitude Lancer had never heard before.
findings.sourceReading: Lancer realizes that the cause of his restraint seems to be the unremarkable thanks he heard only a short while ago.
findings.explanation: Rin's casual thanks just heard becomes gratitude Lancer had never heard before.

contexts.japanese: その原因は、つい先ほど耳にした、なんでもない礼らしい。
contexts.english: The cause seems to be the expression of gratitude that he had never heard before.

findings.description: One treasured jewel becomes plural jewels.
findings.sourceReading: Rin cancels Aero with a single hoarded jewel, identified by its number in the incantation.
findings.explanation: One treasured jewel becomes plural jewels.

contexts.japanese: それを、彼女は秘蔵の宝石で相殺する。
contexts.english: She counters that with her treasured jewels.

findings.description: Crossing countless battlefields undefeated becomes creating a thousand blades.
findings.sourceReading: The verse says he crossed battlefields again and again without defeat.
findings.explanation: Crossing countless battlefields undefeated becomes creating a thousand blades.

contexts.japanese: 幾たびの戦場を越えて不敗。
contexts.english: I have created over a thousand blades.

findings.description: Rin’s commitment to carry her path through becomes merely believing in it.
findings.sourceReading: For as long as she is Archer’s Master, Rin will follow through on the path she believes in, as his former self did.
findings.explanation: Rin’s commitment to carry her path through becomes merely believing in it.

contexts.japanese: 自分の信じた道を貫き通す。
contexts.english: I will believe in my path like he used to do.

findings.description: Dawn beginning becomes completed daybreak.
findings.sourceReading: The night is about to break into dawn as Archer waits in the castle.
findings.explanation: Dawn beginning becomes completed daybreak.

contexts.japanese: 夜が明けようとしていた。
contexts.english: It is daybreak.

findings.description: The no-harm agreement expiring with dawn becomes expiring sometime by dawn.
findings.sourceReading: Archer says the agreement lasts until dawn and disappears when dawn comes, after which Shinji may do as he likes.
findings.explanation: The no-harm agreement expiring with dawn becomes expiring sometime by dawn.

contexts.japanese: それは夜明けとともに消える。
contexts.english: that will disappear by dawn.

findings.description: Lancer's continuing promise not to intervene becomes a report that he has not harmed Rin so far.
findings.sourceReading: Lancer says he is keeping the agreement: he himself will not lay a hand on Rin, whatever others do.
findings.explanation: Lancer's continuing promise not to intervene becomes a report that he has not harmed Rin so far.

contexts.japanese: おまえとの約束は守っている。オレは手出しはせん。
contexts.english: I kept my promise to you. I haven't harmed her.

findings.description: A hypothetical death that cannot erase the original becomes the temporal claim that he has been unable to erase it ever since dying.
findings.sourceReading: Even if this summoned Archer dies, the original Emiya in the Throne outside the cycle will not disappear.
findings.explanation: A hypothetical death that cannot erase the original becomes the temporal claim that he has been unable to erase it ever since dying.

contexts.japanese: ヤツは死んだところで輪の外にある“座”に在るエミヤ本体は消え去らない。
contexts.english: However, ever since he died, he can't erase the original Emiya that exists in a place outside of the time axis.

findings.description: Archer says Shirou should never have become a hero of justice; English says he should never have tried.
findings.sourceReading: Archer corrects 'I' to 'you' and condemns becoming that role, whose completed outcome he has just described.
findings.explanation: Archer says Shirou should never have become a hero of justice; English says he should never have tried.

contexts.japanese: おまえは、正義の味方になぞなるべきではなかった
contexts.english: you never should have tried to be a hero of justice.

findings.description: Waiting until Archer and Saber disappear becomes choosing now to eliminate them.
findings.sourceReading: Kotomine says that once Archer and Saber are gone, the timing will finally be right; meanwhile Rin must be processed quickly before resistance reduces her magical freshness.
findings.explanation: Waiting until Archer and Saber disappear becomes choosing now to eliminate them.

contexts.japanese: アーチャーとセイバーが消えればいい加減頃合いだ。
contexts.english: This would be an opportune time to eliminate Archer and Saber.

findings.description: A heart close to breaking but insisting it has not broken becomes a broken heart pretending to be whole.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou's nearly broken heart bluffs that it is not broken yet, allowing the body to demand continued resistance.
findings.explanation: A heart close to breaking but insisting it has not broken becomes a broken heart pretending to be whole.

contexts.japanese: 折れかかった心が、まだ折れていないと強がっている。
contexts.english: I've just been playing tough, pretending that my broken heart is whole.

findings.description: What Kiritsugu wanted to become becomes what he failed to become.
findings.sourceReading: Archer calls Shirou's ideal an imitation of the thing Kiritsugu wanted to be and believed right.
findings.explanation: What Kiritsugu wanted to become becomes what he failed to become.

contexts.japanese: 衛宮切嗣という男がなりたかったモノ
contexts.english: what Kiritsugu failed to become

findings.description: Nothing remaining after the dust settles becomes nothing else happening.
findings.sourceReading: After the new rubble and settling dust, nothing remains visible; Archer has disappeared from before them.
findings.explanation: Nothing remaining after the dust settles becomes nothing else happening.

contexts.japanese: その後には何もない。
contexts.english: Nothing else happens.

findings.description: An untreated shoulder wound becomes a wound that has not healed.
findings.sourceReading: Shinji has of course received no treatment for the shoulder Lancer stabbed; the next lines describe its present condition without diagnosing healing progress.
findings.explanation: An untreated shoulder wound becomes a wound that has not healed.

contexts.japanese: 当然治療などしていない。
contexts.english: hasn't healed.

findings.description: Shirou asking Saber to remember forever becomes remembering only as long as she can.
findings.sourceReading: He awkwardly wishes that she will remember the house always.
findings.explanation: Shirou asking Saber to remember forever becomes remembering only as long as she can.

contexts.japanese: 出来ればずっと覚えていてくれ
contexts.english: remember it as long as you can.

findings.description: The curse becoming fatal on the first step becomes each step merely approaching fatality.
findings.sourceReading: Its nerve invasion, strength theft, and brain-boiling effect is already lethal once a person takes one step; an ordinary person stops after two.
findings.explanation: The curse becoming fatal on the first step becomes each step merely approaching fatality.

contexts.japanese: 一歩歩いた時点で致命的となる。
contexts.english: every step taken is a step closer to fatality.

findings.description: Saber's felt experience that her body had been cut into four becomes a prediction that it would be cut.
findings.sourceReading: At the instant she threw herself into the opening, she had the bodily conviction that she was cut into four; the next lines explain why she survived intact.
findings.explanation: Saber's felt experience that her body had been cut into four becomes a prediction that it would be cut.

contexts.japanese: 体を四つに断ち切られたと実感した。
contexts.english: She felt her body would be cut in four

findings.description: Approximately two optional selections become exactly two unnecessary items.
findings.sourceReading: Rin says that among the listed points there are about two that do not need to be selected; the deliberately awkward numbers remain approximate pending actual flag verification.
findings.explanation: Approximately two optional selections become exactly two unnecessary items.

contexts.japanese: うち二つばかり選ばなくていいのが混ざっている。
contexts.english: Out of which, two are unnecessary.

findings.description: Shirou discovering one major fact becomes merely learning one thing “at least.”
findings.sourceReading: He reverses his judgment that the questions were pointless because they revealed a single important fact: careless cooking may affect Saber’s mood unpredictably.
findings.explanation: Shirou discovering one major fact becomes merely learning one thing “at least.”

contexts.japanese: 一つだけ重大なコトが判明した。
contexts.english: I was able to learn one thing from these questions, at least.

findings.description: Shirou’s uncertainty about whether pain made him lose consciousness becomes merely being unable to bear it.
findings.sourceReading: He cannot tell whether he finally blacked out because the pain became unbearable or whether the pain stopped unnoticed before he slept.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s uncertainty about whether pain made him lose consciousness becomes merely being unable to bear it.

contexts.japanese: 痛みに耐えきれなくなったのか、それとも知らないうちに痛まなくなったのか。
contexts.english: I must've not been able to bear it anymore, or it stopped hurting before I knew it.

findings.description: Cod hot pot becomes unspecified cod. Shirou's balanced meal planning survives, while the particular dinner he has planned is less concrete.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou plans cod hot pot for dinner and therefore chooses meat for lunch.
findings.explanation: Cod hot pot becomes unspecified cod. Shirou's balanced meal planning survives, while the particular dinner he has planned is less concrete.

contexts.japanese: 夕飯はたら鍋にするんで
contexts.english: The plan is to make cod for dinner

findings.description: A time just before six becomes already six o’clock.
findings.sourceReading: The clock reveals evening shortly before six, with the outside already red.
findings.explanation: A time just before six becomes already six o’clock.

contexts.japanese: 夕方の六時前
contexts.english: already 6 PM

findings.description: A possibly purely enjoyable five-year period becomes the most enjoyable time in Shirou’s entire life.
findings.sourceReading: Looking back, Shirou thinks those five years may have been a time he could enjoy without admixture or reservation.
findings.explanation: A possibly purely enjoyable five-year period becomes the most enjoyable time in Shirou’s entire life.

contexts.japanese: 自分にとって純粋に楽しい時間だったのかもしれない。
contexts.english: that might've genuinely been the most fun time in my life.

findings.description: About half a day becomes an unspecified part of the day.
findings.sourceReading: From the daylight and return home, Shirou infers that only roughly half a day has elapsed.
findings.explanation: About half a day becomes an unspecified part of the day.

contexts.japanese: あれから半日ぐらいしか経ってないのか。
contexts.english: So part of the day has passed since then?

findings.description: Repeating the successful Strengthening loses Shirou’s goal of making the sensation securely his own.
findings.sourceReading: Before the sensation fades, he must repeat the exercise until he has reliably internalized it; failing to capitalize on the rare success would be wasteful.
findings.explanation: Repeating the successful Strengthening loses Shirou’s goal of making the sensation securely his own.

contexts.japanese: 繰り返して、確実にモノにしなければ勿体ない
contexts.english: I need to repeat it so that I don't forget the sensation, or else it would be a waste.

findings.description: Taiga’s question about having the day’s club activity off becomes “morning practice.”
findings.sourceReading: At the afternoon reunion, Rin asks whether club activities are off today.
findings.explanation: Taiga’s question about having the day’s club activity off becomes “morning practice.”

contexts.japanese: 今日は部活動、休みですか？
contexts.english: Are you taking a break from morning practice today?

findings.description: Taiga’s grief-laden remark that Shirou is late returning gains the ordinary-day modifier “today.”
findings.sourceReading: Still looking at the sky before the survival reveal, Taiga says Shirou is late coming home and wonders when he will return.
findings.explanation: Taiga’s grief-laden remark that Shirou is late returning gains the ordinary-day modifier “today.”

contexts.japanese: 帰り、遅いよね士郎
contexts.english: He sure is late today.

findings.description: Rin’s past year of complications becomes a present-tense “I guess I am.”
findings.sourceReading: She concedes that things had indeed been messy, then prepares to explain their origin two years earlier.
findings.explanation: Rin’s past year of complications becomes a present-tense “I guess I am.”

contexts.japanese: ゴタゴタしてたって言えばしてたけど
contexts.english: I guess I am, when you put it that way.

findings.description: People who actually came to Rin’s trial become people she was told would come after it.
findings.sourceReading: Department heads arrive, and unaffiliated mages gather in person to seize interests after the Tohsaka judgment; the crowd makes the trial a parade.
findings.explanation: People who actually came to Rin’s trial become people she was told would come after it.

contexts.japanese: 各部門長はやってくるわ遠坂家が裁かれたあとの利権拾いに来たはぐれ魔術師は集まるわ
contexts.english: They told me how the Lords of each department would come, how stray mages would come to pick up the pieces of the Tohsaka after my sentencing

findings.description: Zelretch’s instruction to select candidates after departmental deliberation becomes a demand to present them after this conference.
findings.sourceReading: Each department must deliberate and then select promising candidates for one of three apprenticeships.
findings.explanation: Zelretch’s instruction to select candidates after departmental deliberation becomes a demand to present them after this conference.

contexts.japanese: 各部門、協議の末見込みのある者を選出せよ
contexts.english: All departments are to present their candidates after this conference.

findings.description: Shirou taking care of dinner becomes cleaning up after dinner.
findings.sourceReading: He tells Rin to rest while he handles preparing the evening meal.
findings.explanation: Shirou taking care of dinner becomes cleaning up after dinner.

contexts.japanese: 晩メシはこっちで片付ける
contexts.english: I'll clean up after dinner

findings.description: Shirou’s ordinary growth and death at the end of his lifespan become growth and death at any time, omitting the normal-lifespan point.
findings.sourceReading: His new embodiment ages, grows, and will die naturally when his lifespan is exhausted, establishing that he is not immortal.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s ordinary growth and death at the end of his lifespan become growth and death at any time, omitting the normal-lifespan point.

contexts.japanese: 成長もするし、寿命を迎えれば天に召される
contexts.english: He'll grow, he'll go to Heaven when he dies

findings.description: The ending says the group has already gained enough to cancel what was lost.
findings.sourceReading: They continue living by weighing what they lost against what they gained and making the accounts work over time.
findings.explanation: The ending says the group has already gained enough to cancel what was lost.

contexts.japanese: 無くなったものと得たものを秤にかけて、帳尻を合わせながらやっていく
contexts.english: We've gained enough to balance out what we lost, and settled our accounts.

findings.description: Sakura’s decision to begin growing one flower per year becomes an already ongoing habit.
findings.sourceReading: Unable to define atonement, she now resolves to grow one flower each year for the promised day.
findings.explanation: Sakura’s decision to begin growing one flower per year becomes an already ongoing habit.

contexts.japanese: 年に一つずつ、花を育てる事にする
contexts.english: I've been growing one flower every year

findings.description: Sakura’s fixed certainty that the promise will be fulfilled becomes an undefined “something” that will compensate for suffering.
findings.sourceReading: She is not sad because she has an absolute certainty: in proportion to the pain, she believes the promised outcome will surely be fulfilled.
findings.explanation: Sakura’s fixed certainty that the promise will be fulfilled becomes an undefined “something” that will compensate for suffering.

contexts.japanese: 悲しくないのは、絶対があるから
contexts.english: I'm not sad because something is absolute.

contexts.japanese: きっと果たされると信じている
contexts.english: I believe that something will happen that makes up for the suffering.

findings.description: A hypothetical disastrous order becomes a prior experience that prevented returning.
findings.sourceReading: 頼んだ日には means if he were to order those dishes, the result would be unbearable.
findings.explanation: A hypothetical disastrous order becomes a prior experience that prevented returning.

contexts.japanese: チンジャオとかホイコーローとか頼んだ日には目も当てられない
contexts.english: I haven't been able to bring myself to return ever since I experienced their char siu and twice-cooked pork.

findings.description: The previous war becomes multiple past wars.
findings.sourceReading: 前回 means the preceding war.
findings.explanation: The previous war becomes multiple past wars.

contexts.japanese: 前回とは違うモノが動いている
contexts.english: something is at work that was not present during past wars.

findings.description: Illya’s qualified approval and Shirou keeping her company become a customary serving of well-regarded sweets.
findings.sourceReading: The sweets seem moderately well received, so he will go on accompanying her normally.
findings.explanation: Illya’s qualified approval and Shirou keeping her company become a customary serving of well-regarded sweets.

contexts.japanese: 微妙に好評のようだし、こっちもいつも通り付き合おう
contexts.english: that we always have with tea.

findings.description: The missed appointment being irretrievable becomes too late to hang out today.
findings.sourceReading: He cannot retroactively keep 今日の約束, so proposes an alternative act now.
findings.explanation: The missed appointment being irretrievable becomes too late to hang out today.

contexts.japanese: 今日の約束は守れない
contexts.english: It's too late to hang out today.

findings.description: Archer raising his weapon becomes a second upward cutting arc.
findings.sourceReading: He lifts the short sword over crawling Zouken in preparation for the interrupted killing blow.
findings.explanation: Archer raising his weapon becomes a second upward cutting arc.

contexts.japanese: 這いずる臓硯に短剣を振り上げるアーチャー
contexts.english: Archer's short sword cuts upward in a second arc.

findings.description: Tracks left by slithering things become things actively slithering on the floor.
findings.sourceReading: 跡 identifies traces of prior movement that Shinji recognizes.
findings.explanation: Tracks left by slithering things become things actively slithering on the floor.

contexts.japanese: 密室の床には、何物かがずるずると蠢いていた跡
contexts.english: Something is slithering and squirming on the floor.

findings.description: Neglected injury swelling becomes future swelling unless Sakura wraps it this way.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura explains that leaving such an injury untreated naturally makes it swell, answering why it hurts now.
findings.explanation: Neglected injury swelling becomes future swelling unless Sakura wraps it this way.

contexts.japanese: こんな怪我してるのに放っておいたら腫れるに決まってるじゃないですかっ
contexts.english: if I don't do that, it's going to swell!

findings.description: Shinji's boast about winning now without Saber becomes another excuse for his earlier defeat. This also weakens the stated basis for Shirou's next inference about what Shinji knows.
findings.sourceReading: After excusing his earlier retreat, Shinji claims that even now he cannot lose provided Saber does not appear.
findings.explanation: Shinji's boast about winning now without Saber becomes another excuse for his earlier defeat. This also weakens the stated basis for Shirou's next inference about what Shinji knows.

contexts.japanese: 今だって、セイバーさえ出てこなければ僕が負ける筈がない
contexts.english: I never would've lost if Saber hadn't shown up!

findings.description: Having been Saber’s Master becomes still being her Master.
findings.sourceReading: だった事に変わりはない preserves the historical fact despite lost current status; eligibility is then explained separately.
findings.explanation: Having been Saber’s Master becomes still being her Master.

contexts.japanese: 貴方がセイバーのマスターだった事に変わりはない
contexts.english: that doesn't mean you aren't Saber's Master.

findings.description: Before five o’clock becomes past five.
findings.sourceReading: 五時前 places the time before the hour.
findings.explanation: Before five o’clock becomes past five.

contexts.japanese: 時刻はもう五時前だ
contexts.english: It's already past five o'clock.

findings.description: One night of being laid up becomes staying a few nights.
findings.sourceReading: 一晩 is one night in the immediate-relocation branch; the delayed branch17 separately anticipates multiple days.
findings.explanation: One night of being laid up becomes staying a few nights.

contexts.japanese: 一晩寝込む事になるなら
contexts.english: staying over here a few nights

findings.description: The rematch branch repeats the current-to-past Saber condition error.
findings.sourceReading: 今だって concerns the present situation and the upcoming encounter: Shinji says he cannot lose as long as Saber stays out of it.
findings.explanation: The English turns a claim about winning the coming rematch into a counterfactual about losing the previous fight.

contexts.japanese: 今だって、セイバーさえ出てこなければ僕が負ける筈がない
contexts.english: I never would've lost if Saber hadn't shown up!

findings.description: Sakura’s much greater heat than this morning becomes fever continuing since this morning.
findings.sourceReading: 朝よりずっと is a comparison of degree, not an onset/duration statement.
findings.explanation: Sakura’s much greater heat than this morning becomes fever continuing since this morning.

contexts.japanese: 桜の体が朝よりずっと熱を持っている
contexts.english: Sakura has had a fever since this morning.

findings.description: Pain from previously grabbing the knife becomes still holding its blade.
findings.sourceReading: ナイフを掴んだ手の痛み is belated awareness of the injury; page0 explicitly discards the knife.
findings.explanation: Pain from previously grabbing the knife becomes still holding its blade.

contexts.japanese: ナイフを掴んだ手の痛み
contexts.english: I'm holding a knife in my left hand by the blade.

findings.description: Initial petrification up to the knees becomes up to the thighs.
findings.sourceReading: 膝まで locates the first stage at the knees; the later stage reaches the waist.
findings.explanation: Initial petrification up to the knees becomes up to the thighs.

contexts.japanese: その両足は、すでに膝まで石化していた
contexts.english: his legs have already petrified up to his thighs.

findings.description: The imminent Rin stabbing is described as completed before the attack turns away.
findings.sourceReading: The spear-like threat changes course immediately before impact; the next page explicitly says it was about to pierce her.
findings.explanation: The imminent Rin stabbing is described as completed before the attack turns away.

contexts.japanese: 目の前にいる遠坂を貫く黒槍を見つめる事しか出来ず
contexts.english: a dark spear stabs Tohsaka.

findings.description: The fantasy of events having been different without Zouken becomes a future remedy, followed by asking what Shirou can do.
findings.sourceReading: His earlier normal-life counterfactual ends if Zouken had not been there; he then challenges what would really have been different without him.
findings.explanation: The fantasy of events having been different without Zouken becomes a future remedy, followed by asking what Shirou can do.

contexts.japanese: あいつさえいなければ、こんな事には
contexts.english: If I can just get rid of him, then all this will...!

contexts.japanese: あいつさえいなければ、何が、どうなったって言うんだ
contexts.english: What can I even do about it?

findings.description: Rin nearly being defeated becomes having lost to Rider.
findings.sourceReading: やられかけた marks the near outcome in Illya’s combat report.
findings.explanation: Rin nearly being defeated becomes having lost to Rider.

contexts.japanese: リンはライダーにやられかけた
contexts.english: Rin lost to Rider.

findings.description: The shock at generations of inherited work being consumed in mere hours loses the hours.
findings.sourceReading: たった数時間 contrasts the treatment duration with generational accumulation.
findings.explanation: The shock at generations of inherited work being consumed in mere hours loses the hours.

contexts.japanese: なんでたった数時間でなくなる
contexts.english: How can you just lose something that's been built up over generations!?

findings.description: Illya being betrayed a second time becomes Shirou having betrayed her twice.
findings.sourceReading: The first betrayal belongs to Kiritsugu, the second to Shirou's repetition of that choice; イリヤは is the victim subject.
findings.explanation: Illya being betrayed a second time becomes Shirou having betrayed her twice.

contexts.japanese: イリヤはこれで二度裏切られた
contexts.english: This marks the second time I've betrayed Illya.

findings.description: An existing bruise becomes a probable future bruise.
findings.sourceReading: 痣になってる is the current result used to explain why pain will persist.
findings.explanation: An existing bruise becomes a probable future bruise.

contexts.japanese: 痣になってるんだし
contexts.english: It'll probably leave a bruise.

findings.description: Arriving still unable to release hands becomes stopping at arrival.

findings.description: The hand's warmth during their return becomes warmth after reaching home.

findings.explanation: The hand's warmth during their return becomes warmth after reaching home.

contexts.japanese: 先輩と一緒に帰ってるときでも
contexts.english: even when we got home

findings.explanation: Present pleasure making recollection too much effort becomes a remembered pleasure from the earlier episode.

findings.description: Sakura's ongoing grave predicament becomes a finished unavoidable ordeal.
findings.sourceReading: 退っ引きならないほど深刻なのに describes her still inescapably serious condition despite his warm recollection.
findings.explanation: Sakura's ongoing grave predicament becomes a finished unavoidable ordeal.

contexts.japanese: 桜は退っ引きならないほど深刻なのに
contexts.english: It was an unavoidable ordeal for Sakura

findings.description: Before five becomes past five.

findings.explanation: Before five becomes past five.

contexts.english: It's already past five o'clock.

findings.explanation: Ten minutes becomes an unspecified sufficient delay.

contexts.japanese: 十分経ったら

findings.description: Three remaining steps becomes three seconds.
findings.sourceReading: 三歩 measures approach distance, not elapsed time.
findings.explanation: Three remaining steps becomes three seconds.

contexts.japanese: あと三歩
contexts.english: In just three seconds,

findings.description: Gastric fluid rising to the mouth becomes vomiting it.
findings.sourceReading: 口まで逆流 states reflux reaching the mouth, not actual expulsion.
findings.explanation: Gastric fluid rising to the mouth becomes vomiting it.

contexts.japanese: 胃液が口まで逆流して
contexts.english: makes me vomit gastric juices

findings.description: The Makiri history that should have ended becomes one that actually ended.
findings.sourceReading: 終わる筈だった sets up the reversal: they did not give up and adopted Sakura.
findings.explanation: The Makiri history that should have ended becomes one that actually ended.

contexts.japanese: そこで終わる筈だった
contexts.english: came to an end.

findings.description: Temporary ordinary life loses its time limit.

findings.explanation: Temporary ordinary life loses its time limit.

contexts.japanese: しばらくは今まで通りの生活ができる
contexts.english: she may be able to continue her daily life.

findings.description: Defeating Sakura first becomes also having to fight her.
findings.sourceReading: 先に桜を倒す is Rin’s tactical conclusion before defeating Zouken, with both priority and result stated.
findings.explanation: Defeating Sakura first becomes also having to fight her.

contexts.japanese: 先に桜を倒すしかない
contexts.english: you'll have to fight Sakura, too.

findings.description: Turning the subject to future consequences becomes postponing discussion until another time.

findings.explanation: Turning the subject to future consequences becomes postponing discussion until another time.

contexts.japanese: 今後の話だ衛宮士郎
contexts.english: Let us discuss this another time, Shirou Emiya.

findings.description: Having accepted the prospect until two days earlier becomes accepting it two days earlier.

findings.explanation: Having accepted the prospect until two days earlier becomes accepting it two days earlier.

contexts.japanese: 少なくとも二日前までは
contexts.english: she accepted that it would come to this, two days ago.

findings.description: Lost determination and absent will to fight become a gradual waning process.

findings.explanation: Lost determination and absent will to fight become a gradual waning process.

contexts.japanese: 今は決心などなくなっている
contexts.english: her determination was waning.

findings.explanation: A dream of events several days ago becomes events of the last few days.

contexts.japanese: 数日前の出来事
contexts.english: the events of the last few days.

findings.description: Already thrown off balance again becomes almost being provoked.

findings.explanation: Already thrown off balance again becomes almost being provoked.

contexts.english: You almost had me going again.

findings.description: Being genuinely ready to attack then becomes now wishing she had attacked.

findings.explanation: Being genuinely ready to attack then becomes now wishing she had attacked.

contexts.japanese: 見た時は本気でその気になった
contexts.english: makes me wish I'd gone for it.

findings.explanation: An uninterrupted rise in nervous heartbeat gains an initially calm first period and invented staged intensities.

contexts.japanese: 胸の動悸はおさまるどころかテンポをあげる一方
contexts.english: In first period it was fine; by second period it was going up; third period it was like I was at a run

findings.explanation: Enjoying Illya as if she were a sister becomes never having had a sister and predicting future fun.

contexts.japanese: 妹みたいで、楽しい
contexts.english: I've never had a little sister before, it'll be fun.

findings.description: Fear of what Saber will do on a lapse becomes a completed beating when Taiga let her guard down.

findings.explanation: Fear of what Saber will do on a lapse becomes a completed beating when Taiga let her guard down.

contexts.english: She pounded me flat as soon as I let my guard down

findings.explanation: A week allowing surrounding events to settle becomes everyone liking the proposed duration.

contexts.japanese: それだけあれば周りも落ち着いていると思う
contexts.english: I think everyone will feel better about that.

findings.description: A request for continuing care becomes thanks for past teaching.

findings.explanation: A request for continuing care becomes thanks for past teaching.

contexts.japanese: ご指導よろしくお願いしますだって
contexts.english: thanked me for teaching you.

findings.description: Past two o’clock becomes the clock striking exactly two.

findings.explanation: Past two o’clock becomes the clock striking exactly two.

contexts.japanese: 午前二時を回っていた
contexts.english: The clock strikes 2:00 AM.

findings.explanation: A blindfold would stop him opening his eyes becomes a claim he never opened them.

contexts.japanese: 目隠しなら誘惑に負けて目蓋を開けることもない

findings.explanation: Lips contacting the side of the neck becomes nipping before the later fang penetration.

contexts.japanese: 首筋に横から
contexts.english: nipping the side of my neck.

findings.explanation: Do not get involved with Shinji for now becomes do not talk to him today.

contexts.japanese: 今は兄さんに関わらないでください
contexts.english: please don't talk to my brother today.

findings.description: Childhood park use lasting until sundown becomes merely someone there during the day.

findings.explanation: Childhood park use lasting until sundown becomes merely someone there during the day.

contexts.japanese: 日が落ちるまで誰かいた
contexts.english: someone here during the day

findings.description: There being no lights in the darkened town becomes lights going out.

findings.explanation: There being no lights in the darkened town becomes lights going out.

contexts.japanese: 町には明かりがなく
contexts.english: The lights go out

findings.description: The mage who had been left only to await death becomes a mage now waiting only for death.

findings.explanation: The mage who had been left only to await death becomes a mage now waiting only for death.

contexts.japanese: 死を待つだけだった老魔術師
contexts.english: The old mage, waiting only for death to claim him

findings.explanation: Rolling down from the mountain gate becomes rolling to a stop at it.

contexts.japanese: 山門から転がり落ちていった
contexts.english: rolls to a stop at the mountain gate

findings.explanation: Rin beginning to amuse herself by teasing him becomes having come solely to tease him.

contexts.english: She only came here to push my buttons.

contexts.english: She's never been here as a guest.

findings.explanation: Being exceptional enough that the Association wants to welcome her becomes personal induction.

contexts.english: personally inducted into the Mage's Association as a prodigy.

findings.description: Not knowing until now becomes still having no idea.

findings.explanation: Not knowing until now becomes still having no idea.

contexts.english: I have no idea what the geezer's been up to this whole time!

findings.explanation: Tension at the initial knife cut becomes tension when picking up a knife.

findings.explanation: A reported resident dragon becomes a former resident.

contexts.japanese: 誘いこむ筈の獲物
contexts.english: the prey he lured out

contexts.english: the vortex of air swallows corridor and skull both

findings.description: Shadow already extended to the waist becomes reaching for the waist.

findings.explanation: Shadow already extended to the waist becomes reaching for the waist.

contexts.japanese: 腰まで伸びた影
contexts.english: reaches for her waist.

contexts.japanese: 俺は何をもって応えるべきなのか

findings.explanation: English restates Shirou's resolve but omits his reminder that he had already declared this commitment.

contexts.japanese: 正義の味方になるって言ったんだ
contexts.english: I'm going to be a man who does what's right.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂とおかしなコトになったワケでもない
contexts.english: I've never done anything that crazy with Tohsaka.

findings.description: The demand to recover by dinner loses the deadline.

findings.description: Nearly a year and a half becomes already a year and a half.

findings.explanation: Nearly a year and a half becomes already a year and a half.

contexts.japanese: もうじき一年半
contexts.english: It's already been a year and a half

findings.description: Picking up the prepared pajamas becomes already changing into them.

findings.explanation: Picking up the prepared pajamas becomes already changing into them.

findings.explanation: Stimulation while consciousness is transferred becomes stimulation before the transfer is done.

findings.description: Minutes of pursuit become more than a moment.

findings.explanation: Minutes of pursuit become more than a moment.

findings.description: The day before yesterday becomes yesterday.

findings.description: No time to work leisurely becomes needing to concentrate.
