findings.sourceReading: マスターを続けさせる intention keeping already ongoing role,12 same requirement.
findings.explanation: Preserve ongoing Master role becomes become Master.

contexts.japanese: アレのマスターを続けさせる為だ。
contexts.english: so that you could become its Master.

findings.description: Cannot maintain awareness becomes would already have lost mind.
findings.sourceReading: 意識を保っていられなくなっている says without current pain cannot sustain consciousness, lapsing records17–18.
findings.explanation: Cannot maintain awareness becomes would already have lost mind.

contexts.japanese: 今みたいに痛みがなければ、意識を保っていられなくなっている
contexts.english: If not for this pain, I'd have lost my mind by now.

findings.description: Before entering forest becomes after leaving forest.
findings.sourceReading: 森に行く前 prior rescue expedition visit desired.
findings.explanation: Before entering forest becomes after leaving forest.

contexts.japanese: 森に行く前にわたしの家に寄っていってほしかった
contexts.english: stopped by my house after you left the forest.

findings.description: Existing possession becomes attempted possession.
findings.sourceReading: 桜が何に取り憑かれてるか current what possesses her.
findings.explanation: Existing possession becomes attempted possession.

contexts.japanese: 桜が何に取り憑かれてるか
contexts.english: what was trying to possess Sakura

findings.description: Return attempt opening becomes return completed before fixing hole.
findings.sourceReading: 座に戻ろうとする瞬間 tiny opening stabilized at onset/attempt to return.
findings.explanation: Return attempt opening becomes return completed before fixing hole.

contexts.japanese: 元の“座”に戻ろうとする瞬間
contexts.english: they return to the Throne they came from

findings.description: No expectation Rider will return becomes bloodlust will never return.
findings.sourceReading: 戻ってくる予感もなかった refers to Rider’s anticipated return after her presence recedes.
findings.explanation: No expectation Rider will return becomes bloodlust will never return.

contexts.japanese: 殺気はもう届かず、戻ってくる予感もなかった。
contexts.english: Her bloodlust is gone, and it doesn't seem like it'll ever return.

findings.description: Rider’s anticipated nonreturn becomes permanent bloodlust nonreturn.
findings.sourceReading: No intuition of her coming back after sensed withdrawal.
findings.explanation: Rider’s anticipated nonreturn becomes permanent bloodlust nonreturn.

contexts.japanese: 殺気はもう届かず、戻ってくる予感もなかった。
contexts.english: Her bloodlust is gone, and it doesn't seem like it'll ever return.

findings.description: Possible future help becomes missed past opportunity.
findings.sourceReading: きっかけさえあれば彼女も力を貸してくれるかもしれない leaves future cooperation possible if an opening arises, conditional on his interpretation being right.
findings.explanation: Possible future help becomes missed past opportunity.

contexts.japanese: それが俺の思い違いでなければ、きっかけさえあれば彼女も力を貸してくれるかもしれない—
contexts.english: Unless I'm imagining it, she might have offered to help me if I'd given her a chance...

findings.description: Earlier question remembered becomes foreknowledge of a future question.
findings.sourceReading: いつか、彼女に問われた事がある says she asked him something at a prior time; next lines struggle to recall what.
findings.explanation: Earlier question remembered becomes foreknowledge of a future question.

contexts.japanese: いつか、彼女に問われた事がある。
contexts.english: I knew this question was coming eventually.

findings.description: Occasional nearly sheer descent becomes mostly small cliffs.
findings.sourceReading: Even descending almost cliff-like rock faces occurred; ほとんど modifies the sheer-cliff comparison, not how often they descended.
findings.explanation: Occasional nearly sheer descent becomes mostly small cliffs.

contexts.japanese: 山には獣道さえなく、ほとんど絶壁じみた岩肌を降りる事さえあった。
contexts.english: There aren't even any game trails out here, and we mostly have to drop down small cliffs and rock walls.

findings.description: Rin holding Sakura off becomes settling the score.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou reads her encouragement as come while she can keep Sakura stopped or contained.
findings.explanation: Rin holding Sakura off becomes settling the score.

contexts.japanese: 要するにあいつは、自分が桜を止めておけるうちに来いと、遠まわしに応援してくれたのだ。
contexts.english: In other words, telling me to come before she settles the score with Sakura was her roundabout way of cheering me on.

findings.description: Not beginning as sword-skill contest becomes no such contest at all.
findings.sourceReading: He must first find an opening; the fight does not start from straightforward competition of sword skill.
findings.explanation: Not beginning as sword-skill contest becomes no such contest at all.

contexts.japanese: ……この戦いは、剣技を競うところからなど始まらない。
contexts.english: ...This battle isn't a contest of sword skills at all.

findings.description: Rule-bound reprieve becomes Saber’s decision and approach allowance.
findings.sourceReading: それが決まりです refers to the rule; reprieve lasts until he steps forward.
findings.explanation: Rule-bound reprieve becomes Saber’s decision and approach allowance.

contexts.japanese: 「……それが決まりですから。貴方が前に踏み出すまでは猶予を与えます。
contexts.english: "...Because I decided so. I will give you time to approach me.

findings.description: One rear ambush becomes multiple in the first simultaneous defense.
findings.sourceReading: At this stage the original thrown Kanshou returns from behind while frontal Bakuya is broken; the second rear Bakuya arrives on135.
findings.explanation: One rear ambush becomes multiple in the first simultaneous defense.

contexts.japanese: 背後からの奇襲と、全力で放った一撃を同時に敵は防いだ。
contexts.english: She just blocked ambushes from behind and a full-power frontal attack, all at the same time.

findings.description: Already tilted scales become future tipping.
findings.sourceReading: どちらに傾いたか refers to which way the scales have tilted after the distant vibration.
findings.explanation: Already tilted scales become future tipping.

contexts.japanese: 天秤がどちらに傾いたかなど、彼女には関心がない。
contexts.english: She doesn't care which way the scales will tip.

findings.description: Eleven years of worm-pit days become days eleven years ago.
findings.sourceReading: 十一年に渡る modifies the duration of the days of 壺毒, eleven years spanning the conditioning.
findings.explanation: Eleven years of worm-pit days become days eleven years ago.

contexts.japanese: だが耐えよ。おまえの体は耐えられるとも。思い出すがよい、十一年に渡る壺毒の日々を！
contexts.english: But bear with it. Your body can take it. Remember the days you spent in the kodoku jar eleven years ago!

findings.description: Not compelling Illya becomes not forcing her to come.
findings.sourceReading: Assassin understands the present policy as not forcing her, responding to Zouken permitting preparation and claiming cooperation.
findings.explanation: Not compelling Illya becomes not forcing her to come.

contexts.japanese: 「…………無理強いはしない、という事か。
contexts.english: "...So you didn't force her to come.

findings.description: Passing the castle gate becomes heading toward it.
findings.sourceReading: The escaping party is in the process of passing through the castle gate after slipping the old mage's grasp.
findings.explanation: Passing the castle gate becomes heading toward it.

contexts.japanese: 油断しきった老魔術師の手をすり抜け、城門を抜けつつあった。
contexts.english: They slipped through the careless old mage's grasp and are headed for the castle gate.

findings.description: Around dawn becomes before dawn.
findings.sourceReading: Illya asks him to return with Sakura and Rin around when night gives way to dawn.
findings.explanation: Around dawn becomes before dawn.

contexts.japanese: 「いってらっしゃいシロウ。夜が明ける頃に、サクラとリンと三人で帰ってきてね」
contexts.english: "Good luck, Shirou. Come home with Sakura and Rin before dawn, okay?"

findings.description: Oversleeping becomes simply falling asleep.
findings.sourceReading: He remembers sometimes being woken when he overslept in the storehouse.
findings.explanation: Oversleeping becomes simply falling asleep.

contexts.japanese: 寝坊した時、たまに起こされるコトもあった。
contexts.english: When I fell asleep here, sometimes she would come to wake me up.

findings.description: An act that seems capable of shredding her nerves becomes one that does shred them. The English removes the qualification while preserving her cool demeanor.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura performs an act that seems liable to shred the nerves throughout her body, while remaining outwardly cool.
findings.explanation: An act that seems capable of shredding her nerves becomes one that does shred them. The English removes the qualification while preserving her cool demeanor.

contexts.japanese: 自らの身体を抉り、全身の神経がズタズタになりそうな行為を、少女は涼しげに笑いながらやってのけた。
contexts.english: The girl gouges out her own body, tearing her own nerves to shreds, all while giggling coolly.

findings.description: Dying throughout body becomes every part already dead.
findings.sourceReading: At this moment portions throughout his body are dying, in ongoing erasure.
findings.explanation: Dying throughout body becomes every part already dead.

contexts.japanese: いや、この瞬間、体のいたるところが死んでいる。
contexts.english: No, in this moment, every part of my body is dead.

findings.description: Potential centimeters to heart become enacted thrust depth.
findings.sourceReading: Blade at his back needs only a further push of a few centimeters to pierce heart.
findings.explanation: Potential centimeters to heart become enacted thrust depth.

contexts.japanese: わずか数センチ、一押しするだけで心臓を穿つ、冷酷な死の重み。
contexts.english: The cold weight of death pushes in only a few centimeters, stopping just short of my heart.

findings.description: Not actually generated from nothing becomes no longer from nothing.
findings.sourceReading: Apparent ex-nihilo manifestation is explained instead as multiple similarities becoming apparent through expansion.
findings.explanation: Not actually generated from nothing becomes no longer from nothing.

contexts.japanese: 空想は混濁と化しながら法則を持ち、無より生じるソレは無より生じたのではなく拡大する事で浮かび上がる多くの類似。
contexts.english: Fantasy becomes chaos with laws. That which came from nothingness no longer comes from nothingness, and many similarities arise through its expansion.

findings.description: Only eight days becomes fewer than eight days.
findings.sourceReading: まだ八日しか is only eight elapsed days; the next self-correction says already eight.
findings.explanation: Only eight days becomes fewer than eight days.

contexts.japanese: 彼女を失ったあの夜から、まだ八日しか経っていない。
contexts.english: Less than eight days have passed since the night I lost her.

contexts.japanese: ……いや、もう八日と言うべきか。
contexts.english: ...No, I guess it's already been that long.

findings.description: Almost losing herself becomes having forgotten herself.
findings.sourceReading: The meal is so delicious that she seems about to lose herself.
findings.explanation: Almost losing herself becomes having forgotten herself.

contexts.japanese: 「ふふ、美味しすぎて我を忘れそう。
contexts.english: "Hehe. She's so delicious I forgot myself.

findings.description: Irrecoverable body and another day of meaningful self become sluggishness and a worthwhile current day.
findings.sourceReading: Body is beyond saving, but stopping now might preserve meaningful selfhood for about a day; the next line calls this one-day life extension.
findings.explanation: Irrecoverable body and another day of meaningful self become sluggishness and a worthwhile current day.

contexts.japanese: この体は手遅れだけど、ここで止めておけば一日ぐらいは意味を失わずに済む。
contexts.english: This body is sluggish, but if I can stop it all here, this day won't have been for nothing.

contexts.japanese: 一日だけの延命。
contexts.english: A one-day lease on life.

findings.description: Interruption before sword creation becomes before sword use.
findings.sourceReading: He would have his skull smashed before creating Saber's sword if he exposed the Projection opening.
findings.explanation: Interruption before sword creation becomes before sword use.

contexts.japanese: そんな隙を見せれば、セイバーの剣を作る前に頭蓋を砕かれている。
contexts.english: If I give him an opening, he'll pulverize my brain before I can use Saber's sword.

contexts.japanese: 投影には時間を要する。
contexts.english: I need time to do it.

findings.description: Until birth becomes as soon as birth.
findings.sourceReading: He claims the entity has no grounds for punishment up to the very instant of birth.
findings.explanation: Until birth becomes as soon as birth.

contexts.japanese: アレは誕生するその瞬間まで、罰を受ける謂れはない」
contexts.english: There is no reason that thing should be punished as soon as it is born."

findings.description: Body beyond saving and another day of meaningful self become sluggishness and worthwhile current day.
findings.sourceReading: Stopping now could preserve meaningful selfhood for about one day although body is already beyond saving; next calls it one-day extension.
findings.explanation: Body beyond saving and another day of meaningful self become sluggishness and worthwhile current day.

contexts.japanese: この体は手遅れだけど、ここで止めておけば一日ぐらいは意味を失わずに済む。
contexts.english: This body is sluggish, but if I can stop it all here, this day won't have been for nothing.

contexts.japanese: 一日だけの延命。
contexts.english: A one-day lease on life.

findings.description: Small remaining reach to sky becomes momentary enacted arm lift.
findings.sourceReading: Sky is just a little farther, reachable merely by extending arm, before he realizes there is no power left and sinks.
findings.explanation: Small remaining reach to sky becomes momentary enacted arm lift.

contexts.japanese: ほんの少し、ただ腕を伸ばすだけで、空へ抜ける。
contexts.english: For just a moment, I lift my arm up and reach into the sky.

contexts.japanese: この体には、一欠片の魔力も残っていない。
contexts.english: There isn't a single bit of power left in this body.

contexts.japanese: 彼女が救ってくれた命が、沈んでいく。
contexts.english: The life she saved is sinking.

contexts.japanese: 手を伸ばす。
contexts.english: I reach out.

findings.description: No human treatment for a long time becomes nobody ever treated her as human.
findings.sourceReading: She says she has long ceased to receive human treatment, then describes bodily alteration.
findings.explanation: No human treatment for a long time becomes nobody ever treated her as human.

contexts.japanese: 当然です、わたしはもうずっと前から人間扱いされてこなかった。目も髪も姉さんとは変わっていって、細胞の隅々までマキリの魔術師になるよう変えられた……！」
contexts.english: Of course I did. Because nobody's ever treated me like one. My hair and my eyes stopped looking like yours. They changed me into a Makiri mage down to my very cells...!"

findings.description: Settling postponed decision becomes earlier determination to keep holding out.
findings.sourceReading: Rin now firms the decision she had postponed, ending wait for Shirou at limit.
findings.explanation: Settling postponed decision becomes earlier determination to keep holding out.

contexts.japanese: 先延ばしにしていた決意を固める。
contexts.english: She's been determined to hold out as long as possible.

contexts.japanese: 限界まで衛宮士郎を待とうとしたが、これ以上は延ばせない。
contexts.english: She waited for Shirou Emiya until the last possible moment, but she can't go on any longer.

findings.description: Rejecting her present self becomes a past deed.
findings.sourceReading: こうしている自分 continues the object of Sakura's rejection: herself in this state, then her bloodied/blackened self and connected shadow.
findings.explanation: Rejecting her present self becomes a past deed.

contexts.japanese: こうしている自分。
contexts.english: She did this.

contexts.japanese: 桜は拒んでいる。
contexts.english: She's in denial.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂の血に濡れた自分、黒く染まった自分、自分に繋がったあの黒い影を、半狂乱になりながら、全力で憎んでいる。
contexts.english: In a near-craze, she hates herself with all her heart—herself for soaking in Tohsaka's blood, herself for being corrupted, herself for connecting to the Shadow.

findings.description: Faintness becomes completed loss of consciousness.
findings.sourceReading: 気が遠くなる describes consciousness receding/faintness while he still moves, speaks and projects before self disappears.
findings.explanation: Faintness becomes completed loss of consciousness.

contexts.japanese: ……気が遠くなる。
contexts.english: ...I lose consciousness.

contexts.japanese: 自分が無くなる前に、前へ。
contexts.english: Before I'm gone, I need to go forward.

findings.description: Hope that the strike will constitute punishment becomes a comparison with final punishment.
findings.sourceReading: これが、桜に下される罰になるように is a wish/purpose: may this become the punishment imposed on Sakura.
findings.explanation: Hope that the strike will constitute punishment becomes a comparison with final punishment.

contexts.japanese: これが、桜に下される罰になるように。
contexts.english: Like this is going to be her final punishment.

contexts.japanese: 「帰ろう桜。—そんなヤツとは縁を切れ」
contexts.english: "Let's go home, Sakura. Cut your ties with that guy."

findings.description: Repeated endured defeats become foreknown future defeat.
findings.sourceReading: Though repeatedly beaten down and repeatedly realizing this body cannot attain it, he could not give up while alive.
findings.explanation: Repeated endured defeats become foreknown future defeat.

contexts.japanese: 幾たび打ちのめされ、何度この身では届かないと悟りながらも、生きている限りは諦められなかった。
contexts.english: He knew he would suffer defeat and that he would not attain it in this body, but he never gave up as long as he lived.

findings.description: Wish to overturn youthful grief becomes result of never overcoming it.
findings.sourceReading: He wanted to overturn the immature grief seen in youth, even by remaking himself.
findings.explanation: Wish to overturn youthful grief becomes result of never overcoming it.

contexts.japanese: 自身を作り変えても、若い頃に見た未熟な悲嘆を覆したかった。
contexts.english: Even when he remade himself, he never overcame the laments of his youth.

findings.description: Dawn just arrived becomes dawn not yet arrived.
findings.sourceReading: 夜明けを迎えたばかり says sky has just greeted dawn and remains dim.
findings.explanation: Dawn just arrived becomes dawn not yet arrived.

contexts.japanese: 夜明けを迎えたばかりの空は薄暗く、今日も灰色の雲で覆われていた。
contexts.english: The dim sky is on the cusp of dawn, and covered in a gray blanket of clouds today.

findings.description: Frame ready sometime today becomes whole-day work.
findings.sourceReading: Somehow frame will be ready within today, then Projection tonight.
findings.explanation: Frame ready sometime today becomes whole-day work.

contexts.japanese: 「だから、例の切り札の作成。なんとか今日中に骨組みが出来るから、今夜“投影”を実行するわ。
contexts.english: "Because you're going to make our secret weapon. We'll spend the entire day making the frame, and then Project it tonight.

findings.description: Confrontation upon successful Projection becomes weapon deciding whether they win.
findings.sourceReading: 成功次第臓硯と決着をつける: as soon as Projection succeeds, move to settling conflict with Zouken.
findings.explanation: Confrontation upon successful Projection becomes weapon deciding whether they win.

contexts.japanese: で、成功次第臓硯と決着をつける。これ以上犠牲者は増やせない。あの影がなんであれ、臓硯を倒せば聖杯戦争は終わる。得体の知れないあの影も、そうなったら消えるでしょ」
contexts.english: It's going to decide whether we win against Zouken. I'm not going to let any more innocent people get hurt. I have no idea what the Shadow is, but the Holy Grail War will end once we take out Zouken. That should cause the Shadow to disappear too."

findings.description: Around a day unconscious becomes favor regretted next day.
findings.sourceReading: Imitating Rider can make him insensible for roughly a full day.
findings.explanation: Around a day unconscious becomes favor regretted next day.

contexts.japanese: ライダーの真似事でいいなら、まる一日前後不覚にしてあげられるけど？」
contexts.english: If you're okay with me copying what Rider did, I'll do you a favor that you'll regret the next day."

findings.description: Sleeping for entire day becomes passing out in middle of day.
findings.sourceReading: If laid up asleep for a full day, cannot wake until tomorrow morning; conflicts with tonight's plan.
findings.explanation: Sleeping for entire day becomes passing out in middle of day.

contexts.japanese: 「やるかバカ！　そんな物騒な実験には付き合えないし、だいたい丸一日寝込んだら明日の朝まで起きられない」
contexts.english: "Hell no! I won't play along with your scary experiments, plus if I pass out in the middle of the day, I won't wake up until tomorrow."

findings.description: As soon as possible becomes as much as possible.
findings.sourceReading: Wants two girls back as sisters at earliest possible time.
findings.explanation: As soon as possible becomes as much as possible.

contexts.japanese: だからあの二人には少しでも早く姉妹に戻ってもらいたい。
contexts.english: That's why I want them to return to being sisters as much as possible.

findings.description: Success credited as already achieved becomes future final success.
findings.sourceReading: This ritual's success was possible only because Shirou was here, Zouken's malicious credit for present result.
findings.explanation: Success credited as already achieved becomes future final success.

contexts.japanese: そう、ワシは感謝しておるよ衛宮士郎。此度の儀はおぬしがいてこその成功だった。
contexts.english: I thank you, Shirou Emiya. The ritual will finally succeed thanks to you.

findings.description: Acquiring the key becomes unlocking the gate. This concerns the ritual's predicted progression and belongs outside this character dossier.
findings.sourceReading: Zouken predicts taking Archer's soul from the girl and seizing the key that leads to the gate.
findings.explanation: Acquiring the key becomes unlocking the gate. This concerns the ritual's predicted progression and belongs outside this character dossier.

contexts.japanese: アインツベルンの聖杯。あの小娘が取り込んだアーチャーの魂を取り込み、門に至る鍵を奪う。
contexts.english: The Einzbern Grail. Once she absorbs that little girl and the Archer she took, Sakura will unlock the gate.

findings.description: Not trusting to the end becomes never putting faith in protector.
findings.sourceReading: Failed to trust the man wanting to protect Sakura through to the end, by leaving.
findings.explanation: Not trusting to the end becomes never putting faith in protector.

contexts.japanese: 「あったりまえじゃない。この家を出た時点で救いきれない大馬鹿よ。アンタは間桐桜を守りたがってたヤツを、最後まで信じてやらなかったんだから」
contexts.english: "Obviously. You're a huge moron, beyond saving from the moment you left this house, because you never put any faith in the one guy who wanted to protect Sakura Matou."

findings.description: Less than a second becomes less than a few seconds.
findings.sourceReading: Meal takes not even one second, 秒もかからなかった.
findings.explanation: Less than a second becomes less than a few seconds.

contexts.japanese: 『食事』は、それこそ秒もかからなかった。
contexts.english: The "meal" doesn't even last a few seconds.

findings.description: Fourth Grail's narrowness becomes fourth war's abruptness.
findings.sourceReading: Fourth Grail too narrow, incomplete with two Servants remaining and gate promptly destroyed.
findings.explanation: Fourth Grail's narrowness becomes fourth war's abruptness.

contexts.japanese: 「四度目の聖杯は狭すぎたのだ。
contexts.english: "The fourth war was too abrupt.

findings.description: Previous-war corruption attached to later Grail use becomes use in previous war.
findings.sourceReading: Her connection formed when using the Grail that had been contaminated in previous war; 前回の戦いで modifies 汚染された within object noun phrase.
findings.explanation: Previous-war corruption attached to later Grail use becomes use in previous war.

contexts.japanese: ……いや、前回の戦いで汚染された聖杯を使用した時点で、彼女はとうに契約していたのだ。
contexts.english: ...No, the moment someone used the corrupted Holy Grail in the previous war, her contract was signed.

contexts.japanese: なにしろ前回の戦いでこの世に漏れた“触覚”を体に埋め込まれ、魔術回路として育てられた人間だ。間桐桜が聖杯として門を開けば開くほど、中にいるモノと一体化していくだろう。
contexts.english: In the last war, its sense of touch, which leaked into this world, was embedded into her body, and she was raised to have it serve as her Magic Circuits. The more Sakura Matou opens the gate as a Holy Grail, the more she will merge with the thing within her.

findings.description: The English dates implantation to the last war. The Japanese dates the leakage to that war and leaves the implantation date unstated.
findings.sourceReading: The previous war dates the leakage of what was subsequently implanted in Sakura. The sentence does not independently date implantation.
findings.explanation: The English dates implantation to the last war. The Japanese dates the leakage to that war and leaves the implantation date unstated.

contexts.japanese: なにしろ前回の戦いでこの世に漏れた“触覚”を体に埋め込まれ、魔術回路として育てられた人間だ。間桐桜が聖杯として門を開けば開くほど、中にいるモノと一体化していくだろう。
contexts.english: In the last war, its sense of touch, which leaked into this world, was embedded into her body, and she was raised to have it serve as her Magic Circuits. The more Sakura Matou opens the gate as a Holy Grail, the more she will merge with the thing within her.

findings.description: Even ending war cannot reset becomes nearing war-end prevents reset.
findings.sourceReading: Even if Grail War ends now, she cannot be restored because already the shadow.
findings.explanation: Even ending war cannot reset becomes nearing war-end prevents reset.

contexts.japanese: 彼女は既にあの影そのものだ。もはや聖杯戦争が終わったところで、彼女を元に戻す事はできん」
contexts.english: She is already the Shadow itself. Now that the Holy Grail War is in its final days, she will be unable to return to her former self."

findings.description: Kirei's argument shifts from predicting a child's future criminality to accusing it of its parent's crimes. The change concerns his analogy, not Shirou's stated principles.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei asks whether a criminal's son is certain to become a criminal, making prenatal killing the consequence of that prediction.
findings.explanation: Kirei's argument shifts from predicting a child's future criminality to accusing it of its parent's crimes. The change concerns his analogy, not Shirou's stated principles.

contexts.japanese: それともなにか？　おまえは犯罪者の息子は間違いなく犯罪者になるとでも言うのか？　それ故に、生まれる前に殺してしまえと？」
contexts.english: Or are you saying that you would condemn the child of a criminal and accuse it of the same crimes? Would you execute it before it is even born?"

findings.description: Defend only after birth becomes defend to achieve birth.
findings.sourceReading: Only when entity born as life will he defend it; before delivery Sakura refusal respected.
findings.explanation: Defend only after birth becomes defend to achieve birth.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯の中にあるモノ。それが生命として誕生した時のみ、ソレを擁護する。出産の前に間桐桜が子を拒むのであらば、そちらの意思を尊重しよう」
contexts.english: I protect that which is within the Holy Grail, so that it may be born. If its mother rejects her child before it is born, then I will respect her wishes."

findings.description: Control within seconds becomes holding control for seconds, impossibility becomes miracle.
findings.sourceReading: Gaining Grail control within merely seconds is madness; alone boy cannot accomplish it under any circumstances.
findings.explanation: Control within seconds becomes holding control for seconds, impossibility becomes miracle.

contexts.japanese: それだけではない。わずか数秒で聖杯を制御するなど狂気の沙汰だ。おまえ一人では、どうあっても成しえない奇跡だぞ」
contexts.english: That's not all. It would be a mind-shattering task to control the Holy Grail for even a few seconds. Such a feat would be a miracle for you alone."

findings.description: Future progressive destruction becomes already emotionless doll.
findings.sourceReading: Abusive taunt: fear, trembling, eventually losing feeling until no different from doll.
findings.explanation: Future progressive destruction becomes already emotionless doll.

contexts.japanese: おまえは間桐の女だ。卑しい魔術師くずれ、恐れ、怯え、やがて感情をなくし人形と変わらなくなる！」
contexts.english: You're a Matou woman. A lowly, cowardly has-been of a mage, no different from an emotionless doll!"

findings.description: Present bodily suffering relieved becomes all pain ever felt abolished.
findings.sourceReading: Upon acceptance current terribly suffering body becomes miraculously easy.
findings.explanation: Present bodily suffering relieved becomes all pain ever felt abolished.

contexts.japanese: ただ、受け入れた途端、あれだけ苦しかった体が嘘のように楽になった。
contexts.english: All she knows is that the moment she accepted her shadow, all the pain she'd ever felt vanished like a dream.

findings.description: Present imagined defeats become promised future victories matching old fantasies.
findings.sourceReading: She defeats those who threatened her within present imagination; next joy in imagined acts.
findings.explanation: Present imagined defeats become promised future victories matching old fantasies.

contexts.japanese: 少女は自らを脅かし続けたモノたちを想像の中で倒していく。
contexts.english: She'll defeat everyone who's threatened her, just as she always imagined.

contexts.japanese: そのイメージ、想像上の行為だけで歓喜に満たされる。
contexts.english: The thought alone fills her with unexpected joy.

findings.description: Present normal conversation becomes a conditional future restoration.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou tries to maintain that Sakura is unchanged: she is thus talking properly to him as usual, before her refusal interrupts.
findings.explanation: Present normal conversation becomes a conditional future restoration.

contexts.japanese: こうして、ちゃんと俺と話をして、いつも通り—
contexts.english: So if we can just talk, she'll go back to—

contexts.japanese: 桜は桜のままだ。
contexts.english: Sakura is still Sakura.

findings.description: Denial of a cause becomes a not-yet absorption event.
findings.sourceReading: His paralysis is not because he was overwhelmed by her enormous magical energy; the next sentences identify her intent to kill him as its cause.
findings.explanation: Denial of a cause becomes a not-yet absorption event.

contexts.japanese: その膨大すぎる魔力に呑まれた訳じゃない。
contexts.english: I haven't been swallowed by this titanic magical energy yet.

contexts.japanese: 体を凍らせるのはただ一つ。
contexts.english: There's only one reason I can't move:

contexts.japanese: 桜は本気で—俺に、殺意を向けていた。
contexts.english: Sakura's boundless bloodlust is directed at me.

findings.description: Irrecoverably disabling Rin is softened to neutralizing her.
findings.sourceReading: 再起不能 specifies making Rin unable to recover/get back up, alongside killing Shirou and absorbing Rider.
findings.explanation: Irrecoverably disabling Rin is softened to neutralizing her.

contexts.japanese: 「言葉通りの意味よ。ライダーを取り込んでもシロウを殺してもリンを再起不能にしても、今のサクラには意味がないってコト。時間の無駄だし、八つ当たりはそのあたりにしておいたら？」
contexts.english: "Exactly what I said. You can consume Rider, kill Shirou, and neutralize Rin, but it's pointless to you right now. You're just wasting time, so why don't you stop the temper tantrum already?"

findings.description: Deciding to settle the matter becomes already settling scores.
findings.sourceReading: 決着をつけるコトにした says Sakura has decided to bring the matter to a conclusion.
findings.explanation: Deciding to settle the matter becomes already settling scores.

contexts.japanese: 「それに、サクラは決着をつけるコトにしたんでしょう？
contexts.english: "And you've settled your scores, haven't you?

findings.description: Already discovered fact becomes a future revelation.
findings.sourceReading: 今回判明した事実 is fact discovered this time; it will continue into the future.
findings.explanation: Already discovered fact becomes a future revelation.

contexts.japanese: 今回判明した事実は、この先ずっと続いていく。
contexts.english: Once the truth comes out, it'll hound me for a while to come.

findings.description: Loss of memory of her own actions becomes fear about future behavior.
findings.sourceReading: When focus slips she no longer knows what she had been doing; memories vague, limb sensations gone and subjective day fragmented.
findings.explanation: Loss of memory of her own actions becomes fear about future behavior.

contexts.japanese: 今はちゃんとしてるけど、気を抜くとね、自分が何をしていたか分からなくなるの。……日に日に記憶が曖昧になって、手足の感覚もない。時間の感覚だってもうバラバラで、一日が長く続いてくれないんだ。
contexts.english: I'm still myself now, but if I lose focus, I don't know what I'll do... My memories are getting more vague each day, and I can't feel my arms and legs anymore. My sense of time is all over the place, and I can't even keep track of a day anymore.

findings.description: Apparent week since farewell becomes week during farewell.
findings.sourceReading: Though she saw him off this morning it feels a week has passed since doing so.
findings.explanation: Apparent week since farewell becomes week during farewell.

contexts.japanese: ……今朝だって。なんか、先輩を見送ってから、一週間ぐらい経ってる気がするの」
contexts.english: ...Even this morning, when I watched Senpai leave, it felt like a whole week went by."

findings.description: Sakura's surprise at Rider's unsolicited concern becomes surprise that Rider has offered any suggestion. This weakens the explicit recognition of care between them.
findings.sourceReading: What surprises Sakura is Rider taking the initiative to express concern for her in this way.
findings.explanation: Sakura's surprise at Rider's unsolicited concern becomes surprise that Rider has offered any suggestion. This weakens the explicit recognition of care between them.

contexts.japanese: それが今のように、自ら彼女を案じるなど今までなかった事だ。
contexts.english: Until now, she's never made so much as a suggestion.

findings.description: Excluding last night's activity as cause becomes not tired at bedtime.
findings.sourceReading: A lot happened yesterday, but he thinks fatigue isn't due to last night's events, with embarrassed hesitation.
findings.explanation: Excluding last night's activity as cause becomes not tired at bedtime.

contexts.japanese: たしかに昨日は色々あったが、別に、その、昨夜のことで疲れたワケじゃないと思う。
contexts.english: A lot happened yesterday, but I didn't go to bed particularly exhausted.

findings.description: Shallow sleep becomes insufficient quantity of sleep.
findings.sourceReading: He supposes sluggishness from shallow/light sleep.
findings.explanation: Shallow sleep becomes insufficient quantity of sleep.

contexts.japanese: この気だるさは眠りが浅かったせいだろう。
contexts.english: I probably feel this way because I didn't sleep enough.

findings.description: Charging through the knee-deep Shadow becomes already free of it after waist-deep engulfment.
findings.sourceReading: Berserker charges while scattering the black Shadow in which he is sunk to his knees.
findings.explanation: Charging through the knee-deep Shadow becomes already free of it after waist-deep engulfment.

contexts.japanese: バーサーカーは地面を、膝まで沈みこんだ黒い影を蹴散らしながら突進する。
contexts.english: Berserker kicks his way out of the ground, free of the black Shadow that had swallowed him up to the waist, and charges.

contexts.japanese: バーサーカーを封じているのは足元の沼だけでなく、黒い影は全身に絡みついて巨人を縛している。
contexts.english: Not only was he being constricted by the mud at his feet. The Shadow also had him entirely bound.

contexts.japanese: 故に、巨人はその身を裂いた。
contexts.english: So he decided to tear himself free.

findings.description: Less than a day's extension becomes a full extra day.
findings.sourceReading: The hypothetical medicine prolongs life by only less than one day.
findings.explanation: Less than a day's extension becomes a full extra day.

contexts.japanese: おぬしとて木々の一本一本が寿命を延ばす妙薬とすれば、この森など瞬く間に食らいつくそう。たとえそれが、僅か一日足らずの延命だとしてもな。
contexts.english: If you knew that each tree in this forest could be made into a drug to extend your life, even you would cut down the whole forest in an instant. Even if it only meant an extra day of life.

findings.description: The forest's present death becomes a future prediction.
findings.sourceReading: As the Shadow surges and drains surrounding magical energy, the forest dies.
findings.explanation: The forest's present death becomes a future prediction.

contexts.japanese: 森が死ぬ。
contexts.english: This forest will die.

contexts.japanese: 周囲にある全ての魔力があの影に吸われていく。
contexts.english: All of the surrounding mana is being sucked into the Shadow.

findings.description: The shared objective survives, but the English leaves out Rin's explicit limit: cooperating until Zouken is defeated.
findings.sourceReading: Rin offers cooperation until their shared objective of defeating Zouken is achieved.
findings.explanation: The shared objective survives, but the English leaves out Rin's explicit limit: cooperating until Zouken is defeated.

contexts.japanese: だいたいね、貴方だけじゃ心許ないでしょ。臓硯を倒すって目的は一緒なんだし、それまで手を組んであげてもいいってコト！」
contexts.english: I bet you aren't feeling great about fighting alone, either. We both want to take down Zouken, so I'll team up with you if that's what you want!"

contexts.japanese: 「そうよ、協力してあげてもいいって言ってるのっ！
contexts.english: "Yeah, I'm saying that I'll work together with you!

findings.description: A limit to Shirou's own thinking becomes being out of ideas at this point.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou says what he can devise alone is limited and Rin's ideas would make the plan surer.
findings.explanation: A limit to Shirou's own thinking becomes being out of ideas at this point.

contexts.japanese: 俺の考えじゃ限界があるし、遠坂が知恵を出してくれるならその方が確実だ」
contexts.english: I'm out of ideas at this point, so any knowledge you can spare would give me a surer idea of what to do."

findings.description: Saber's blade stopping at a single layer of skin becomes stopping shy of the neck.
findings.sourceReading: The sword has reached Shirou and stops at the thin skin of his neck, leaving his head attached.
findings.explanation: Saber's blade stopping at a single layer of skin becomes stopping shy of the neck.

contexts.japanese: セイバーの剣は、俺の薄皮一枚で止まっている。
contexts.english: Saber's sword stops just shy of my neck.

findings.description: Understanding the mechanism of pain becomes getting used to it.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou thinks he has more or less grasped how the pain works, then explains his cooling/heat-transfer model.
findings.explanation: Understanding the mechanism of pain becomes getting used to it.

contexts.japanese: ……痛みの仕組みがどんなモノなのかはだいたい呑み込めた。
contexts.english: ...I've more or less gotten used to how the pain works.

findings.description: A guest room Rin noticed inside the detached annex on a prior visit becomes a separate guesthouse seen on the way here.
findings.sourceReading: Rin asks to be shown to the guest room in the detached annex, which she had marked out when previously admitted into the house.
findings.explanation: A guest room Rin noticed inside the detached annex on a prior visit becomes a separate guesthouse seen on the way here.

contexts.japanese: ほら士郎、客間に案内して。前に上がった時、離れの客間に目をつけてたんだから。あ、イリヤはどこがいい？」
contexts.english: Come on, Shirou, take me to a guestroom. I saw a separate guesthouse on the way here. Oh, where do you want to sleep, Illya?"

findings.description: The detached-annex guest room Rin noticed on an earlier visit again becomes a separate guesthouse seen on the way there.
findings.sourceReading: Rin asks for the guest room in the detached annex that she marked out when previously admitted into the house.
findings.explanation: The detached-annex guest room Rin noticed on an earlier visit again becomes a separate guesthouse seen on the way there.

contexts.japanese: 「決まりね。それじゃあがらせてもらうわよ。ほら士郎、客間に案内して。前に上がった時、離れの客間に目をつけてたんだから。あ、イリヤはどこがいい？」
contexts.english: "That settles it then. I'm coming in. Come on, Shirou, take me to a guestroom. I saw a separate guesthouse on the way here. Oh, where do you want to sleep, Illya?"

contexts.japanese: 「？　いや、桜の部屋は離れの客間だけど」
contexts.english: "Huh? Sakura's room is in the separate guesthouse."

findings.description: Covers already kicked away during sleep become Shirou kicking them off after waking.
findings.sourceReading: He wakes from difficult sleep with sweat-heavy pajamas and the quilt already kicked away.
findings.explanation: Covers already kicked away during sleep become Shirou kicking them off after waking.

contexts.japanese: 寝巻きは汗を吸って重く、掛け布団は蹴り飛ばされている。
contexts.english: My pajamas are heavy with sweat. I kick off the covers.

findings.description: Actually undoing the cloth becomes merely trying to undo it.
findings.sourceReading: On impulse Shirou removes/undoes the cloth for an instant, experiences the fragmented recoil, and rewinds it.
findings.explanation: Actually undoing the cloth becomes merely trying to undo it.

contexts.japanese: 一瞬、思いつきのまま布を解いた。
contexts.english: For a second, I tried undoing the cloth wrap.

findings.description: Shirou being Sakura's salvation becomes him having already saved her.
findings.sourceReading: Rider says the trustworthy core beneath his immaturity is why he was/is a source of salvation for Sakura.
findings.explanation: Shirou being Sakura's salvation becomes him having already saved her.

contexts.japanese: 貴方は未熟で不器用ですが、その芯にあるものは信用に足ります。だからこそ、サクラにとって貴方は救いだったのでしょう」
contexts.english: You are clumsy and inexperienced, but trustworthy at your core. That is how you have saved Sakura."

findings.description: Kirei stripping Shirou naked becomes merely exposing some skin.
findings.sourceReading: He undoes the restraint belts and readily leaves Shirou naked, revealing the wrapped foreign arm.
findings.explanation: Kirei stripping Shirou naked becomes merely exposing some skin.

contexts.japanese: 神父は拘束着のベルトを解いて、あっさりと俺を裸にした。
contexts.english: The priest undoes the belt, exposing my skin.

findings.description: A past era when Kirei still had a wish becomes an era of waiting for that wish to come true.
findings.sourceReading: He looks back more than ten years to the period when he still possessed something called a wish.
findings.explanation: A past era when Kirei still had a wish becomes an era of waiting for that wish to come true.

contexts.japanese: もう十年以上も過去となった、まだ望みとやらを持っていた時代の事を。
contexts.english: ...at a time more than ten years past, when he still waited for his wish to come true.

findings.description: A possible answer becomes a necessary answer.
findings.sourceReading: If such an unwanted being is truly conceived, Kirei thinks perhaps that may be the thing he seeks.
findings.explanation: A possible answer becomes a necessary answer.

contexts.japanese: もし、本当にそんなものを受胎するというのであらば、或いはそれこそが—
contexts.english: If such a being can truly be conceived, that must be...

findings.description: Saber and Kiritsugu surviving to the end becomes winning the war.
findings.sourceReading: Saber says she cooperated with Kiritsugu and remained/won through to the final stage of the previous war.
findings.explanation: Saber and Kiritsugu surviving to the end becomes winning the war.

contexts.japanese: 前回の聖杯戦争のおり、衛宮切嗣はマスターの一人でした。私は彼と協力して聖杯戦争に挑み、最後まで勝ち残りました。
contexts.english: Kiritsugu Emiya was one of the Masters in the last Holy Grail War. I fought alongside him for the Grail, and we won.

findings.description: Shirou lacking the nerve to open the church door becomes opening it.
findings.sourceReading: Although he came at Saber's urging, Shirou cannot summon the spirit to push open the door and question Kirei about ten years ago.
findings.explanation: Shirou lacking the nerve to open the church door becomes opening it.

contexts.japanese: あの扉を押し開け、神父に十年前の出来事を尋ねる気概が生まれない。
contexts.english: As I push on the door, I don't feel particularly motivated to ask the priest about what happened ten years ago.

findings.description: The final critical moment becomes an altar.
findings.sourceReading: 土壇場で means at the last moment or in the final crunch: Kiritsugu discarded everything at the decisive end.
findings.explanation: The final critical moment becomes an altar.

contexts.japanese: 「その全てを、ヤツは土壇場で切り捨てた。
contexts.english: "He cast all of them aside on that altar.

findings.description: Risking Shirou's own life each night becomes weighing lives in general.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei tells Shirou, like Kiritsugu, to put his own life on the scales night after night and lure out his target.
findings.explanation: Risking Shirou's own life each night becomes weighing lives in general.

contexts.japanese: 「十分だ。それがおまえの戦う意義ならば、死を賭して戦うがいい。長引けばそれだけ犠牲者は出る。切嗣と同じよう、夜毎己が命を秤にかけて標的を誘き寄せろ」
contexts.english: "That is sufficient. If that is what drives you, then fight like your life depends on it. The longer it lasts, the more victims there will be. Do as Kiritsugu did and weigh lives on a balance, all to lure out your objective."

findings.description: Sakura seeming strange two days ago becomes looking strange throughout the last two days.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou recalls that Sakura also seemed odd two days earlier.
findings.explanation: Sakura seeming strange two days ago becomes looking strange throughout the last two days.

contexts.japanese: 思えば二日前の桜も様子が変だった。
contexts.english: Come to think of it, Sakura has looked off for the last two days.

findings.description: Uncertainty whether even one comparable Servant appeared becomes a recalled definite example.
findings.sourceReading: Zouken judges that perhaps not even one Servant of Saber's caliber appeared in past wars.
findings.explanation: Uncertainty whether even one comparable Servant appeared becomes a recalled definite example.

contexts.japanese: 「……ふむ。なるほど、これではライダーが敗れるのも道理。さぞ名のある英霊とお見受けした。これほどのサーヴァント、過去の戦いにおいても一人現れたかどうか」
contexts.english: "...Hm, I see. It's little wonder Rider lost. You are a Heroic Spirit of some renown. I seem to recall a Servant as powerful as this in one of the past wars."

findings.description: Zouken's claim that he has been away for roughly ten years disappears. The same interval instead describes the apprentice's growth, changing his explanation for his limited knowledge.
findings.sourceReading: Zouken attributes his unfamiliarity with the previous head's apprentice to having been away for about ten years.
findings.explanation: Zouken's claim that he has been away for roughly ten years disappears. The same interval instead describes the apprentice's growth, changing his explanation for his limited knowledge.

contexts.japanese: ここ十年ばかり留守にしておった故、彼奴の弟子がどれほどの器かは見知らぬが」
contexts.english: I wonder how much of a mage their apprentice has grown into these past ten years."

findings.description: An already concluded defeat becomes an intended withdrawal.
findings.sourceReading: Zouken says Shinji has lost and Matou's participation in this war has consequently ended early, then asks whether Saber will still cut him down.
findings.explanation: An already concluded defeat becomes an intended withdrawal.

contexts.japanese: 「ともあれ、慎二は敗れた。此度の戦いは早々に我らの敗退となったが—それでもこの老体を斬るかね、セイバーのサーヴァントよ」
contexts.english: "In any case, Shinji has lost. We intend to withdraw early from the war this time...but you would still cut this old man down, Saber?"

findings.description: Shirou starting to run after handing over the woman becomes Saber starting to run.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou entrusts the woman to Saber and sets off running; she then announces she will lead and moves ahead.
findings.explanation: Shirou starting to run after handing over the woman becomes Saber starting to run.

contexts.japanese: 女性をセイバーに預けて走り出す。
contexts.english: Saber takes the woman and starts running.

findings.description: Saber jumping backward becomes flinching and taking one step.
findings.sourceReading: She springs backward with a sustained shuffling sound after Shirou calls her properly a girl.
findings.explanation: Saber jumping backward becomes flinching and taking one step.

contexts.japanese: ざざ、と後ろに跳び退くセイバー。
contexts.english: Saber flinches and takes a step back.

findings.description: Fulfilling an overdue promise becomes doing a promise.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou thinks he must now properly fulfill the promise that should have been exchanged at the beginning.
findings.explanation: Fulfilling an overdue promise becomes doing a promise.

contexts.japanese: 交わすべきだった約束を、ここできちんと果たさないと。
contexts.english: I have to make her a promise that I should have done from the beginning.

findings.description: Ten minutes of silence becomes the end of Shirou's explanation.
findings.sourceReading: It has already been ten minutes since he gave the brief lodging explanation.
findings.explanation: Ten minutes of silence becomes the end of Shirou's explanation.

contexts.japanese: と説明してからはや十分。
contexts.english: That's all the explanation I give.

findings.description: Inviting Rin inside because of a small connection becomes her stopping by the other day.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou's cover story says a minor connection led him to have Rin come into the house.
findings.explanation: Inviting Rin inside because of a small connection becomes her stopping by the other day.

contexts.japanese: 「ああ。ちょっとした縁で家にあがってもらったんだ。
contexts.english: "Yeah. She stopped by the other day.

findings.description: A future identity as a champion of justice becomes habitual correct behavior.
findings.sourceReading: The fragment reasserts the vow: Shirou Emiya will become a champion of justice, for the sake of people unjustly killed.
findings.explanation: A future identity as a champion of justice becomes habitual correct behavior.

contexts.japanese: 衛宮士郎は正義の味方に。
contexts.english: Shirou Emiya always does the right thing.

findings.description: Shirou's confused inventory becomes a future Master problem and romantic fixation.
findings.sourceReading: Already a Master, Shirou says his head is a jumble of the justice ideal, growing up, making everyone happy, and the blond girl who came with him.
findings.explanation: Shirou's confused inventory becomes a future Master problem and romantic fixation.

contexts.japanese: 切嗣の言っていた正義の味方ってどんなモノなのかとか、早く一人前になる方法とか、切嗣の口癖だったみんなが幸せでいられればいい、なんて魔法みたいな夢の実現方法とか、それと、マスターなんてモノになっちまって、一緒に付いてきた金髪の女の子とか頭んなかがゴチャゴチャだ、ホント—
contexts.english: What did Kiritsugu mean by doing the right thing and championing justice? How can I grow up faster? Is there some magical way to make Kiritsugu's dream of 'making everyone happy' come true? Seriously, what am I supposed do when I become a Master and I can't get the blonde girl with me out of my head—

findings.description: Near-instant death becomes unqualified instant death.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou believes he should have been almost instantly dead.
findings.explanation: Near-instant death becomes unqualified instant death.

contexts.japanese: 俺、ほぼ即死だった筈じゃないか？
contexts.english: I should've died instantly.

findings.description: Ten minutes becomes a few minutes.
findings.sourceReading: After about ten minutes of spontaneous healing, Shirou's outward appearance had returned to normal.

contexts.japanese: 無理をすればまだこの世に留まれる
contexts.english: She can stay in this world if she pushes herself.

counterexamples.description: Gilgamesh's concession remains limited to this moment.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He says Shirou is stronger now and withdraws from this immediate defeat.
counterexamples.explanation: Gilgamesh's concession remains limited to this moment.

contexts.japanese: 今はおまえが強い
contexts.english: At this moment, you are stronger than me

counterexamples.description: The external flash remains the cause of Reality Marble collapse.
counterexamples.sourceReading: A pond-side burst of vast mana blows away the already fading field.
counterexamples.explanation: The external flash remains the cause of Reality Marble collapse.

contexts.japanese: 強大な魔力が、消えかけていた固有結界を消し飛ばした
contexts.english: The massive magical energy wiped away the already disappearing Reality Marble.

counterexamples.description: The scene ends with both branches of danger unresolved.
counterexamples.sourceReading: If Shirou is pulled in, both fall; if he holds, Gilgamesh returns and kills him.
counterexamples.explanation: The scene ends with both branches of danger unresolved.

contexts.japanese: もし持ち堪えられたとしても、その時はヤツがこの場に戻ってしまう
contexts.english: Even if I hold out, he'll pull himself out then.

counterexamples.description: Changing Shirou's future does not erase the already existing Guardian.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The knight and boy are now separate existences even if EMIYA is not born along the boy's new path.
counterexamples.explanation: Changing Shirou's future does not erase the already existing Guardian.

contexts.japanese: 既に存在してしまっている赤い騎士は、永遠に守護者で有り続ける
contexts.english: The knight in red that already exists will forever be a Guardian.

counterexamples.description: The pendant's two routes and deferred contradiction survive.
counterexamples.sourceReading: One unique pendant was returned from Rin's room; another was picked up and stored in Shirou's desk.
counterexamples.explanation: The pendant's two routes and deferred contradiction survive.

contexts.japanese: その矛盾を、今は追及する時ではない
contexts.english: Now is not the time to be pursuing that contradiction.

counterexamples.description: Rain remains prospective while the air smells post-rain.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou wonders whether rain will begin soon under a cloudy sky carrying a rain-after scent.
counterexamples.explanation: Rain remains prospective while the air smells post-rain.

contexts.japanese: じき、雨が降るのだろうか
contexts.english: Is it going to start raining soon?

counterexamples.description: The battle's end includes either side losing.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Once one side moves, the Caster battle will end whether Shirou and Rin lose or Rin defeats Caster first.
counterexamples.explanation: The battle's end includes either side losing.

contexts.japanese: 俺と遠坂が破れるにしろ、その前に遠坂がキャスターを倒すにしろ
contexts.english: Whether Tohsaka and I get defeated or Tohsaka defeats Caster before that

counterexamples.description: The cross-matchups' instant-death logic survives.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin would die in a breath against Kuzuki and Caster could end Shirou by pointing, whereas the selected matchups buy time without promising victory.
counterexamples.explanation: The cross-matchups' instant-death logic survives.

contexts.japanese: この組み合わせなら勝てないまでも瞬殺される事はない。
contexts.english: we might not be able to win, but at least we won't get killed in an instant.

counterexamples.description: The nine remaining jewels and willingness to spend them survive.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin enters prepared to expend the remaining nine of ten irreplaceable jewels built over more than ten years.
counterexamples.explanation: The nine remaining jewels and willingness to spend them survive.

contexts.japanese: 代えのない十の宝石のうち、残る九つ
contexts.english: the remaining nine out of ten irreplaceable jewels.

counterexamples.description: Saber limits her nonaggression to the present.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She tells Lancer to leave and says she will not fight him now, without declaring a permanent truce.
counterexamples.explanation: Saber limits her nonaggression to the present.

contexts.japanese: 私も、今は貴方とは戦わない
contexts.english: I will not fight you now.

counterexamples.description: The bidirectional relation between summoning age and origin age survives.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Guardians can be summoned into every age and can be summoned from present, past, or unseen future.
counterexamples.explanation: The bidirectional relation between summoning age and origin age survives.

contexts.japanese: まだ見ぬ未来からですら、英霊となるモノなら呼び出せる
contexts.english: Heroic Spirits can even be summoned from the future we have not yet seen.

counterexamples.description: The recovery remains partial rather than universal.
counterexamples.sourceReading: After half a day Shirou’s fatigue, headache, and limb sensation recover, while his circuits remain depleted.
counterexamples.explanation: The recovery remains partial rather than universal.

contexts.japanese: 魔術回路はさすがに消耗したまま
contexts.english: Magic Circuit that I overused is still exhausted

counterexamples.description: The three travelers’ spacing and deadline survive.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Saber hurries after Shirou while Lancer follows at a distance; they leave at midnight expecting to arrive by the deadline.
counterexamples.explanation: The three travelers’ spacing and deadline survive.

contexts.japanese: ランサーはそんな俺たちと距離を保ったまま、飄々と付いてくる。
contexts.english: Lancer keeps his distance from us and follows us aloofly.

counterexamples.description: Arm sensation and total fighting strength remain separate measures.
counterexamples.sourceReading: About half the arm sensation remains, while total power is under one tenth and independent action is near its limit.
counterexamples.explanation: Arm sensation and total fighting strength remain separate measures.

contexts.japanese: 残された力は、もはや元の一割にも満たない。
contexts.english: remaining strength is less than a tenth of his original powers.

counterexamples.description: The all-books-at-once and future-record model survives.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Past and future do not order the records; all books are present from the start, including future cleanup knowledge.
counterexamples.explanation: The all-books-at-once and future-record model survives.

contexts.japanese: 彼の部屋には初めから全ての『本』がある。
contexts.english: All the "books" are already in his room.

counterexamples.description: Eternity and an instant remain equivalent.
counterexamples.sourceReading: For Archer, eternity is an instant and an instant eternity, preventing him from measuring how long he waited.
counterexamples.explanation: Eternity and an instant remain equivalent.

contexts.japanese: 永遠は一瞬であり、一瞬は永遠なのだ。
contexts.english: An eternity is an instant, and an instant is an eternity.

counterexamples.description: The five-used and three-remaining estimate is preserved.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Archer counts the fifth projected copy and estimates three remain at Shirou's current capacity.
counterexamples.explanation: The five-used and three-remaining estimate is preserved.

contexts.japanese: その様では残り三本。
contexts.english: You look like you have three left

counterexamples.description: The circuits' progression from prior damage to complete break is preserved.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Yesterday's Projection burned the circuits; what was already near failure has now completely broken.
counterexamples.explanation: The circuits' progression from prior damage to complete break is preserved.

contexts.japanese: 壊れかけたものが完全に壊れただけ。
contexts.english: Something that was about to break is now completely broken

counterexamples.description: The arm-collecting violence remains a future plan.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shinji decides his first act will be taking arms from everyone, beginning with Rin.
counterexamples.explanation: The arm-collecting violence remains a future plan.

contexts.japanese: まっさきにする事は、腕という腕を集める事。
contexts.english: His first goal is to gather arms.

counterexamples.description: The defective Grail remains incomplete and predicted to finish later.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Growth and decay currently balance; adaptation should let growth win, completing the Grail soon.
counterexamples.explanation: The defective Grail remains incomplete and predicted to finish later.

contexts.japanese: そう時を待たずして、彼の聖杯は完成するだろう。
contexts.english: his Holy Grail will soon be complete.

counterexamples.description: Shirou's current belief that destroying the Grail sends Saber back is preserved.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He understands Grail destruction as the time of Saber's return because she is a Servant.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou's current belief that destroying the Grail sends Saber back is preserved.

contexts.japanese: サーヴァントであるセイバーの帰還の時
contexts.english: Saber will leave too because she's a Servant.

counterexamples.description: The second holy-sword use and its disappearance cost are explicit.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Saber believes she can fire twice and will disappear at the instant of the second strike.
counterexamples.explanation: The second holy-sword use and its disappearance cost are explicit.

contexts.japanese: 二度目の一撃を放った瞬間自分が消滅する
contexts.english: she will disappear the instant she uses it the second time.

counterexamples.description: The gate does not imply indefinite survival.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Caster supplied about twenty days of energy, already exceeded, and Assassin will not last until dawn.
counterexamples.explanation: The gate does not imply indefinite survival.

contexts.japanese: 夜明けまで持たぬ身だ。
contexts.english: I won't even last until dawn.

counterexamples.description: Gilgamesh's reprieve remains only the minutes until the cocoon hatches.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He grants life solely so guests can stand as scarecrows and witness the emergence.
counterexamples.explanation: Gilgamesh's reprieve remains only the minutes until the cocoon hatches.

contexts.japanese: 繭が孵るまでの数分
contexts.english: until the cocoon hatches.

counterexamples.description: The apparent several-second pause is correctly revised to less than one second.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Saber's decision feels suspended but in fact takes under a second.
counterexamples.explanation: The apparent several-second pause is correctly revised to less than one second.

contexts.japanese: 数秒……いや、実際は一秒もなかっただろう。
contexts.english: A few seconds...no, not even a second passed.

counterexamples.description: The first three good-ending checkpoints retain their dates and times.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin lists night of day three, morning of day five, and after school on day eight without supplying omitted targets.
counterexamples.explanation: The first three good-ending checkpoints retain their dates and times.

contexts.japanese: 三日目夜に連れ戻す。
contexts.english: Bring her back on the third night.

counterexamples.description: The apparently anomalous day-fifteen dojo hint is not silently corrected to the file's day fourteen.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin explicitly says night of day fifteen, a claim reserved for later route-flag checking.
counterexamples.explanation: The apparently anomalous day-fifteen dojo hint is not silently corrected to the file's day fourteen.

contexts.japanese: 十五日目夜に道場。
contexts.english: Go to the dojo on the fifteenth night.

counterexamples.description: The warning that focusing too much on Saber prevents passing day twelve remains intact.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin cautions that Saber-focused choices can block progress beyond the twelfth day.
counterexamples.explanation: The warning that focusing too much on Saber prevents passing day twelve remains intact.

contexts.japanese: セイバーにかまけてると十二日目を越えられない。
contexts.english: You won't be able to get past the twelfth day if you're too preoccupied with Saber.

counterexamples.description: Taiga’s delayed recognition of Rin remains the center of the joke.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She accepts the greeting, walks through, gets food, and only then shouts about Rin’s presence.
counterexamples.explanation: Taiga’s delayed recognition of Rin remains the center of the joke.

contexts.japanese: なんで遠坂さんが士郎んとこにいるのかーーーーーー！！！！
contexts.english: WHY IS TOHSAKA AT SHIROU'S PLACEEE!!!???

counterexamples.description: The snowfall duration and uncertain remaining accumulation are preserved.
counterexamples.sourceReading: It snowed only about two hours, so Shirou estimates little snow remains in the garden.
counterexamples.explanation: The snowfall duration and uncertain remaining accumulation are preserved.

contexts.japanese: 結局二時間ほどしか降らなかったから、庭にはかすかな雪しか残っていないだろう。
contexts.english: It only snowed for about two hours, so I bet there's only a bit of snow left in the yard.

counterexamples.description: The second plate is still only dropped after twenty minutes.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The narration counts drops, not breaks, at this point.
counterexamples.explanation: The second plate is still only dropped after twenty minutes.

contexts.japanese: 床に落とした皿はこれで二枚目だ。
contexts.english: This is the second plate I dropped.

counterexamples.description: The fourth plate is correctly distinguished as actually broken.
counterexamples.sourceReading: After three cushioned drops, the fourth plate shatters when his left hand fails.
counterexamples.explanation: The fourth plate is correctly distinguished as actually broken.

contexts.japanese: 舌打ちして割れた皿を見下ろす。
contexts.english: I click my tongue and look down at the broken plate.

counterexamples.description: Rin’s opposing judgment that nine is still very early remains intact.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She rejects Shirou’s lateness premise and heads back to finish the discussion quickly.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin’s opposing judgment that nine is still very early remains intact.

contexts.japanese: なんだ、まだ全然早いじゃない。
contexts.english: Oh, it's still early...

counterexamples.description: Shellfish remains something Shirou has not yet served and Saber has rarely eaten.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The exchange avoids inventing established familiarity.
counterexamples.explanation: Shellfish remains something Shirou has not yet served and Saber has rarely eaten.

contexts.japanese: 貝類はまだ食べてないよなセイバー
contexts.english: you haven't had any shellfish yet, right?

counterexamples.description: Shirou still refuses three mandarins and takes only two initially.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The later third mandarin is meaningful because he first declares three too many after dinner.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou still refuses three mandarins and takes only two initially.

contexts.japanese: 差し出されたミカンを二つ手にとって
contexts.english: I take two mandarins from her hand

counterexamples.description: School remains a detour Rin chooses because student life is fun.
counterexamples.sourceReading: It is not required by her magus path but is neither meaningless nor wasteful.
counterexamples.explanation: School remains a detour Rin chooses because student life is fun.

contexts.japanese: 無駄じゃないわよ？　学生って楽しいもの。
contexts.english: I wouldn't say it's a waste, though. Being a student is fun.

counterexamples.description: Rin’s challenge remains scheduled for tomorrow rather than immediate combat.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She promises to make Shirou admit defeat the next day; the plan itself is still unexplained.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin’s challenge remains scheduled for tomorrow rather than immediate combat.

contexts.japanese: 明日、アンタに参ったって言わせてやる
contexts.english: I'll make you admit defeat tomorrow.

counterexamples.description: The numbness expands beyond the leg to the arm and left chest.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The whole left side is affected rather than one foot alone.
counterexamples.explanation: The numbness expands beyond the leg to the arm and left chest.

contexts.japanese: 左胸をつねってみると、これまた痛みも感触もない。
contexts.english: I try pinching the left side of my chest and feel nothing there as well.

counterexamples.description: Taiga corrects “work” into hospital visiting.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She initially calls it work, then backs off and identifies the activity more casually.
counterexamples.explanation: Taiga corrects “work” into hospital visiting.

contexts.japanese: お仕事……じゃないか。単にお見舞いに回ってるだけ
contexts.english: I had to work... Well, no. I was just going around visiting those in the hospital.

counterexamples.description: The hospital report remains about current severity and expected return next week.
counterexamples.sourceReading: No one is presently critical; after observation all are expected back the following week.
counterexamples.explanation: The hospital report remains about current severity and expected return next week.

contexts.japanese: 今は病院で様子を見てるだけで、週があければみんな元気に登校できるって。
contexts.english: They're all just staying at the hospital to be safe, and they said that everyone can go back to school next week.

counterexamples.description: The school day disappears subjectively rather than as an ordinary scene cut.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou recognizes that bodily abnormality disrupted his time sense, memory of lessons, and memory of his actions.
counterexamples.explanation: The school day disappears subjectively rather than as an ordinary scene cut.

contexts.japanese: 自分が何をしていたかも曖昧だ。
contexts.english: I'm not too sure of what I did either.

counterexamples.description: This remains Rin’s subsequent home visit rather than her first entry into the house.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou remembers her treating him there on Saber’s summoning night.
counterexamples.explanation: This remains Rin’s subsequent home visit rather than her first entry into the house.

contexts.japanese: 手当てをしてくれたのは遠坂だった。
contexts.english: It was Tohsaka who treated me

counterexamples.description: The trio eats lunch before beginning the four-hour planning session.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin’s food demand is fulfilled; discussion does not replace lunch.
counterexamples.explanation: The trio eats lunch before beginning the four-hour planning session.

contexts.japanese: 昼食をとった後、今後の方針を語り合った。
contexts.english: the three of us eat lunch and then talk about our future plans.

counterexamples.description: The scene opens immediately before midnight under the frozen moon.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou’s routine is fixed at the day’s change and the visual image remains cold and nocturnal.
counterexamples.explanation: The scene opens immediately before midnight under the frozen moon.

contexts.japanese: 日付が替わろうとする午前零時、凍えた月を見上げながら
contexts.english: Right before midnight, I look up at the frozen moon

counterexamples.description: The former single-digit Strengthening success rate and Shirou’s initial Master hypothesis survive.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He first wonders whether becoming a Master explains the sudden ease, then rejects that explanation.
counterexamples.explanation: The former single-digit Strengthening success rate and Shirou’s initial Master hypothesis survive.

contexts.japanese: マスターになったからなのか、成功率一桁だった強化は難なく行える
contexts.english: I don't know if it's because I became a Master, but Strengthening got a lot easier. I used to only have a success rate in the single digits.

counterexamples.description: Archer’s warning forbids magecraft for the whole following day and preserves the worse-than-numbness consequence.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The condition is improving but not immediately safe.
counterexamples.explanation: Archer’s warning forbids magecraft for the whole following day and preserves the worse-than-numbness consequence.

contexts.japanese: 明日一日は魔術を使おうと思うなよ。
contexts.english: don't even think about using any magecraft tomorrow.

counterexamples.description: The unusual sword count retains both numerical bounds and subjective uncountability.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The count exceeds ten or twenty, remains below one or two hundred, yet may as well be unlimited to a human unable to count it.
counterexamples.explanation: The unusual sword count retains both numerical bounds and subjective uncountability.

contexts.japanese: 人に数えきれぬのであらば、それは無限と呼ばれるだろう。
contexts.english: if someone can't count them all, the total number may as well be unlimited.

counterexamples.description: The count of three enemy attacks is retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou uses the repeated attacks to force himself out of indecision.
counterexamples.explanation: The count of three enemy attacks is retained.

contexts.japanese: すでに三回も敵に襲われている。
contexts.english: I've been attacked by enemies three times already.

counterexamples.description: Constant expenditure and increased battle consumption remain explicit.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Recovery competes with ongoing cost, which rises during combat.
counterexamples.explanation: Constant expenditure and increased battle consumption remain explicit.

contexts.japanese: 戦闘となればその消費量はさらに勢いを増す。
contexts.english: it is lost at an ever-increasing pace during battle.

counterexamples.description: Saber’s exact five-meter following distance is retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Her silent pursuit is spatially precise.
counterexamples.explanation: Saber’s exact five-meter following distance is retained.

contexts.japanese: きっかり五メートルの距離
contexts.english: exactly five meters behind me.

counterexamples.description: Shirou promises to stay through the end of practice and invites Sakura to dinner.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Her expression changes after concrete continued time together.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou promises to stay through the end of practice and invites Sakura to dinner.

contexts.japanese: 部活が終わるまで学校にいるよ
contexts.english: I might as well stay until practice is over.

counterexamples.description: Taiga retains the quotation requiring more than two hundred arrows per day.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The quantitative ideal remains exact.
counterexamples.explanation: Taiga retains the quotation requiring more than two hundred arrows per day.

contexts.japanese: 日に二百以上の矢数をかけよ
contexts.english: shoot 200 arrows a day

counterexamples.description: The rarity limit of roughly one master per generation remains.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Saber does not generalize correct breathing as common.
counterexamples.explanation: The rarity limit of roughly one master per generation remains.

contexts.japanese: 一世代に一人いればいい方
contexts.english: only one person per generation

counterexamples.description: The improvised 300–600-square-meter range remains numerical.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Its near-twofold breadth enables Saber’s criticism.
counterexamples.explanation: The improvised 300–600-square-meter range remains numerical.

contexts.japanese: 三百から六百

counterexamples.description: Shirou limits Saber’s stay to a short while while denying cohabitation.
counterexamples.sourceReading: His defensive framing remains temporary lodging.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou limits Saber’s stay to a short while while denying cohabitation.

contexts.japanese: ほんのちょっとの間だけ
contexts.english: only staying for a short while.

counterexamples.description: Taiga says she will contact Sakura’s family, not that contact is already complete.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The plan remains prospective.
counterexamples.explanation: Taiga says she will contact Sakura’s family, not that contact is already complete.

contexts.japanese: わたしから連絡入れておく
contexts.english: I'll contact your family

counterexamples.description: The stealthy departure remains fixed at 11 PM.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The house is dark and silent.
counterexamples.explanation: The stealthy departure remains fixed at 11 PM.

contexts.japanese: 時刻は午後十一時。
contexts.english: It's 11 PM.

counterexamples.description: The 200-arrows maxim remains a recollection rather than 200 shots performed now.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou quotes it before switching to magecraft training.
counterexamples.explanation: The 200-arrows maxim remains a recollection rather than 200 shots performed now.

contexts.japanese: 日に二百以上の矢をかけろ、か
contexts.english: Shoot over 200 arrows, huh?

counterexamples.description: Strengthening succeeded for the first time in years and still requires repeated practice.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou has not mastered it at will.
counterexamples.explanation: Strengthening succeeded for the first time in years and still requires repeated practice.

contexts.japanese: 何年かぶりに成功した
contexts.english: succeeded in Strengthening for the first time in a few years.

counterexamples.description: The blast remains explicitly single-use.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Broken Phantasm expends one burst of magical energy through the Noble Phantasm.
counterexamples.explanation: The blast remains explicitly single-use.

contexts.japanese: ただ一度きりの魔力の炸裂
contexts.english: a one-time explosion of magical energy

counterexamples.description: The exact late-night time is retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou leaves for training at 11 PM.
counterexamples.explanation: The exact late-night time is retained.

contexts.japanese: 時刻は午後十一時
contexts.english: It's 11 PM.

counterexamples.description: Shirou closes the door before turning on the stove.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The physical sequence of shutting out the air and heating the room is preserved.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou closes the door before turning on the stove.

contexts.japanese: 扉を閉めて外気を遮断し
contexts.english: Closing the door behind me to shut out the cold air

counterexamples.description: The successful Strengthening remains the first in several years.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The rare success is not normalized into routine mastery.
counterexamples.explanation: The successful Strengthening remains the first in several years.

contexts.japanese: 何年かぶりに成功した強化の魔術
contexts.english: I succeeded in Strengthening for the first time in a few years.

counterexamples.description: Zelretch’s remark still places the Tohsaka achievement at six generations.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The genealogy and speed of reaching the result remain intact.
counterexamples.explanation: Zelretch’s remark still places the Tohsaka achievement at six generations.

contexts.japanese: わずか六代で辿り着く
contexts.english: you would reach it in a mere six generations

counterexamples.description: Rin’s inability to finance the Jeweled Sword within even one or two decades remains explicit.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Her technical capability is separated from practical affordability.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin’s inability to finance the Jeweled Sword within even one or two decades remains explicit.

contexts.japanese: 一年二年、いや十年二十年でどうにかなるレベルではない
contexts.english: It's more than I could gather in a year or two—no, a decade or two.

counterexamples.description: Sakura’s postwar behavior remains a forced performance of being fine rather than simple recovery.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The English preserves the strain even while weakening its purpose relation.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura’s postwar behavior remains a forced performance of being fine rather than simple recovery.

contexts.japanese: 無理やり平気なフリをし続けた
contexts.english: She kept pretending everything was fine
